class ResignationReviewForm(forms.Form):
    decision = forms.ChoiceField(
        choices=(
            ("APPROVED", "Accept Resignation"),
            ("REJECTED", "Reject Resignation"),
        ),
        widget=forms.Select(
            attrs={
                "class": "form-control",
            }
        ),
    )

    final_last_working_date = forms.DateField(
        label="Final Last Working Date",
        required=False,
        widget=forms.DateInput(
            attrs={
                "type": "date",
                "class": "form-control",
            }
        ),
    )

    remarks = forms.CharField(
        label="HR Remarks",
        required=False,
        widget=forms.Textarea(
            attrs={
                "class": "form-control",
                "rows": 4,
                "placeholder": "Add HR remarks.",
            }
        ),
    )

    def clean(self):
        cleaned_data = super().clean()

        decision = cleaned_data.get("decision")
        remarks = (cleaned_data.get("remarks") or "").strip()

        if decision == "REJECTED" and not remarks:
            self.add_error(
                "remarks",
                "HR remarks are required when rejecting a resignation.",
            )

        final_date = cleaned_data.get(
            "final_last_working_date"
        )

        if (
            decision == "APPROVED"
            and final_date
            and final_date < timezone.localdate()
        ):
            self.add_error(
                "final_last_working_date",
                "Final last working date cannot be in the past.",
            )

        return cleaned_data

class HolidayForm(forms.ModelForm):
    def __init__(self, *args, org, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        self.org = org

    def clean(self):
        cleaned_data = super().clean()
        name = cleaned_data.get("name")
        holiday_date = cleaned_data.get("date")

        if name and holiday_date:
            duplicates = Holiday.objects.filter(
                organization=self.org,
                name__iexact=name.strip(),
                date=holiday_date,
            )
            if self.instance.pk:
                duplicates = duplicates.exclude(pk=self.instance.pk)
            if duplicates.exists():
                raise forms.ValidationError(
                    "A holiday with this name and date already exists."
                )

        return cleaned_data

    class Meta:
        model = Holiday
        fields = [
            "name",
            "date",
            "holiday_type",
            "description",
            "is_active",
        ]

        widgets = {
            "name": forms.TextInput(
                attrs={"class": "form-control"}
            ),
            "date": forms.DateInput(
                attrs={
                    "class": "form-control",
                    "type": "date",
                }
            ),
            "holiday_type": forms.Select(
                attrs={"class": "form-control"}
            ),
            "description": forms.Textarea(
                attrs={
                    "class": "form-control",
                    "rows": 3,
                }
            ),
        }

class HolidayBulkUploadForm(forms.Form):
    file = forms.FileField(
        label="Holiday File",
        help_text="Upload .xlsx or .csv file."
    )

    def clean_file(self):
        uploaded_file = self.cleaned_data["file"]

        allowed_extensions = (
            ".xlsx",
            ".csv",
        )

        if not uploaded_file.name.lower().endswith(
            allowed_extensions
        ):
            raise forms.ValidationError(
                "Please upload an Excel (.xlsx) or CSV (.csv) file."
            )

        return uploaded_file

class WorkScheduleForm(forms.ModelForm):

        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        self.org = org

    def clean_name(self):
        name = self.cleaned_data["name"].strip()
        duplicates = WorkSchedule.objects.filter(
            organization=self.org,
            name__iexact=name,
        )
        if self.instance.pk:
            duplicates = duplicates.exclude(pk=self.instance.pk)

        return name

            "friday",
            "saturday",

            "is_active",
        ]

class OptionalHolidayRequestForm(forms.ModelForm):

    class Meta:
        model = OptionalHolidayRequest

        fields = [
            "holiday",
            "reason",
        ]

        widgets = {
            "holiday": forms.Select(
                attrs={
                    "class": "form-control",
                }
            ),

            "reason": forms.Textarea(
                attrs={
                    "class": "form-control",
                    "rows": 3,
                    "placeholder": "Reason (optional)",
                }
            ),
        }

    def __init__(
        self,
        *args,
        employee=None,
        **kwargs,
    ):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)

        today = timezone.localdate()

        holidays = Holiday.objects.filter(
            organization_id=getattr(employee, "organization_id", None),
            holiday_type="OPTIONAL",
            is_active=True,
            date__gte=today,
        ).order_by("date")

        # Don't show holidays already requested
        # by this employee.
        if employee:
            requested_holiday_ids = (
                OptionalHolidayRequest.objects
                .filter(
                    employee=employee,
                )
                .values_list(
                    "holiday_id",
                    flat=True,
                )
            )

            holidays = holidays.exclude(
                id__in=requested_holiday_ids,
            )

        self.fields["holiday"].queryset = holidays

        self.fields["holiday"].empty_label = (
            "Select Optional Holiday"
        )

class empDocumentForm(forms.ModelForm):
    class Meta:
        model = empDocument  # noqa: F821 (defined in your models.py)
        fields = ["document_type", "file"]
 
    def __init__(self, *args, org, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)

        self.fields["document_type"].queryset = (
            self.fields["document_type"].queryset.filter(
                organization=org, is_active=True
            )
        )

        if "employee" in self.fields:
            self.fields["employee"].queryset = (
                self.fields["employee"].queryset.filter(organization=org)
            )

    def clean_file(self):
        file = self.cleaned_data["file"]
        original_size = file.size

        compressed_file = compress_image_if_needed(file)

        if compressed_file.size != original_size:
            self.compression_info = {
                "original_kb": original_size / 1024,
                "compressed_kb": compressed_file.size / 1024,
            }
        else:
            self.compression_info = None

        return compressed_file

class BCASPassForm(forms.ModelForm):
    class Meta:
        model = BCASPass
        fields = [
            "employee",
            "pass_type",
            "airport",
            "issue_date",
            "expiry_date",
            "access_zones",
            "issuing_authority",
            "remarks",
        ]

        widgets = {
            "issue_date": forms.DateInput(
                attrs={"type": "date", "class": "form-control"}
            ),
            "expiry_date": forms.DateInput(
                attrs={"type": "date", "class": "form-control"}
            ),
            "access_zones": forms.TextInput(
                attrs={
                    "class": "form-control",
                    "placeholder": "e.g. APRON, TERMINAL, ATC, CARGO",
                }
            ),
            "issuing_authority": forms.TextInput(
                attrs={
                    "class": "form-control",
                    "placeholder": "e.g. BCAS Regional Office, Ahmedabad",
                }
            ),
            "remarks": forms.Textarea(
                attrs={"class": "form-control", "rows": 3}
            ),
        }

    def __init__(self, *args, org, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)

        self.fields["employee"].queryset = (
            empProfile.objects
            .filter(organization=org, is_active=True)
            .select_related("user")
            .order_by("user__first_name", "user__last_name")
        )

        self.fields["airport"].queryset = (
            Airport.objects
            .filter(is_active=True)
            .order_by("state", "name")
        )

        for name, field in self.fields.items():
            if isinstance(field.widget, forms.CheckboxInput):
                field.widget.attrs["class"] = "form-check-input"
            else:
                field.widget.attrs.setdefault("class", "form-control")

    def clean(self):
        cleaned_data = super().clean()
        issue_date = cleaned_data.get("issue_date")
        expiry_date = cleaned_data.get("expiry_date")

        if issue_date and expiry_date and expiry_date < issue_date:
            self.add_error(
                "expiry_date",
                "Expiry date cannot be before the issue date."
            )

        return cleaned_data

class WageRegisterEntryRowForm(forms.Form):
    """One row in the bulk monthly wage-register run. Every field except
    salary_id is optional — leaving a field blank means 'use the auto-
    calculated value', matching WageRegisterEntry's own override logic."""
    salary_id = forms.IntegerField(widget=forms.HiddenInput)

    rate_override = forms.DecimalField(
        required=False, max_digits=10, decimal_places=2,

from io import StringIO

COLS = ["aadhar_no", "pan_no", "bank_account_no", "uan_no", "esic_no", "phone_number", "address"]
AADHAAR_A = "234567890123"
AADHAAR_B = "345678901234"
PHONE_A = "9876500001"


def raw(pk, col):
    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        cursor.execute('SELECT "%s" FROM "appEmp_empprofile" WHERE id = %%s' % col, [pk])
        return cursor.fetchone()[0]


def raw_all():
    cols = ", ".join('"%s"' % c for c in COLS)
    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        cursor.execute('SELECT id, %s FROM "appEmp_empprofile" ORDER BY id' % cols)
        return cursor.fetchall()


class Base(TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpTestData(cls):
        User.objects.bulk_create([
            User(username="zz_su", email="zz_su@example.com", is_staff=True, is_superuser=True, password="!")
        ])
        cls.su = User.objects.get(username="zz_su")
        cls.org1 = Organization.objects.create(name="ZZ Org One", created_by=cls.su)
        cls.org2 = Organization.objects.create(name="ZZ Org Two", created_by=cls.su)

    def make(self, org, email, **fields):
        user = User(username=email, email=email, first_name="Zz", last_name="Test")
        user.set_unusable_password()
        user._organization = org
        user.save()
        profile = P.objects.get(user=user)
        if fields:
            for key, value in fields.items():
                setattr(profile, key, value)
            profile.save()
        return profile


class StorageAndFormTests(Base):
    def test_values_are_stored_as_ciphertext(self):
        p = self.make(self.org1, "zz_a@example.com", aadhar_no=AADHAAR_A, pan_no="ABCDE1234F",
                      bank_account_no="123456789012", uan_no="100200300400", esic_no="5566778899",
                      phone_number=PHONE_A, address="1 Test Street")
        for col in COLS:
            self.assertTrue(raw(p.pk, col).startswith("enc1:"), col)
        fresh = P.objects.get(pk=p.pk)
        self.assertEqual(fresh.aadhar_no, AADHAAR_A)
        self.assertEqual(fresh.address, "1 Test Street")

    def test_employee_form_round_trip(self):
        p = self.make(self.org1, "zz_b@example.com")
        data = {"first_name": "Zz", "last_name": "Test", "email": "zz_b@example.com",
                "phone_number": "9123456780", "state": "", "zip_code": "", "address": "12 Test Street"}
        form = EmployeeForm(data, instance=P.objects.get(pk=p.pk))
        self.assertTrue(form.is_valid(), form.errors)
        form.save()
        fresh = P.objects.get(pk=p.pk)
        self.assertEqual(fresh.phone_number, "9123456780")
        self.assertEqual(fresh.address, "12 Test Street")
        self.assertEqual(fresh.phone_bidx, phone_index("9123456780"))
        self.assertEqual(EmployeeForm(instance=fresh).initial.get("phone_number"), "9123456780")

    def test_admin_form_round_trip(self):
        group = Group.objects.create(name="ZZ_TEST_GROUP")
        p = self.make(self.org1, "zz_c@example.com")
        data = {"first_name": "Zz", "last_name": "Test", "email": "zz_c@example.com",
                "access_group": group.pk, "phone_number": "9123456781", "address": "Admin address"}
        form = ProfileFormAdmin(data, instance=P.objects.get(pk=p.pk), request_user=self.su)
        self.assertTrue(form.is_valid(), form.errors)
        self.assertEqual(form.cleaned_data["phone_number"], "9123456781")

    def test_save_with_update_fields_leaves_aadhaar_fingerprint_alone(self):
        p = self.make(self.org1, "zz_d@example.com", aadhar_no=AADHAAR_A)
        before = p.aadhar_bidx
        p.pan_no = "ABCDE1234F"
        p.save(update_fields=["pan_no"])
        self.assertEqual(P.objects.get(pk=p.pk).aadhar_bidx, before)
        p.phone_number = PHONE_A
        p.save(update_fields=["phone_number"])
        self.assertEqual(P.objects.get(pk=p.pk).phone_bidx, phone_index(PHONE_A))

    def test_encrypted_columns_refuse_searches(self):
        with self.assertRaises(FieldError):
            list(P.objects.filter(pan_no="x"))
        with self.assertRaises(FieldError):
            list(P.objects.filter(phone_number__icontains="9"))


class AadhaarTests(Base):
    def test_same_number_in_two_orgs_is_refused_by_the_database(self):
        self.make(self.org1, "zz_e@example.com", aadhar_no=AADHAAR_A)
        p2 = self.make(self.org2, "zz_f@example.com")
        spaced = "2345 6789 0123"
        for value in (AADHAAR_A, spaced):
            with self.assertRaises(IntegrityError), transaction.atomic():
                p2.aadhar_no = value
                p2.save()

    def test_clean_refuses_duplicate_without_naming_the_org(self):
        p1 = self.make(self.org1, "zz_g@example.com", aadhar_no=AADHAAR_A)
        p2 = self.make(self.org2, "zz_h@example.com")
        p1.clean()
        p2.aadhar_no = AADHAAR_A
        with self.assertRaises(ValidationError) as ctx:
            p2.clean()
        self.assertNotIn(self.org1.name, " ".join(ctx.exception.messages))

    def test_malformed_aadhaar_is_rejected(self):
        p = self.make(self.org1, "zz_i@example.com")
        p.aadhar_no = "123"
        with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
            p.save()

    def test_many_profiles_can_have_no_aadhaar(self):
        self.make(self.org1, "zz_j@example.com")
        self.make(self.org2, "zz_k@example.com")
        self.assertEqual(P.objects.filter(aadhar_bidx__isnull=True).count(), 2)


class PhoneTests(Base):
    def test_search_matches_full_number_only(self):
        p = self.make(self.org1, "zz_l@example.com", phone_number=PHONE_A)

        def found(text):
            request = SimpleNamespace(GET={"q": text}, current_org=self.org1)
            return _filtered_emp_queryset(request)[0].filter(pk=p.pk).exists()

        self.assertTrue(found(PHONE_A))
        self.assertTrue(found("+91 98765 00001"))
        self.assertFalse(found("987650"))
        self.assertTrue(found("Zz"))

    def test_router_returns_one_match_or_none(self):
        p1 = self.make(self.org1, "zz_m@example.com", phone_number=PHONE_A)
        self.assertEqual(find_employee_by_phone("91" + PHONE_A), p1)
        self.assertIsNone(find_employee_by_phone("919999900000"))
        self.assertIsNone(find_employee_by_phone("12345"))
        self.assertIsNone(find_employee_by_phone(""))
        self.make(self.org2, "zz_n@example.com", phone_number=PHONE_A)
        self.assertIsNone(find_employee_by_phone("91" + PHONE_A))


class AdminAndImportTests(Base):
    def test_admin_hides_sensitive_fields_from_non_superusers(self):

        model_admin = admin.site._registry[P]

        def fields_for(user):
            request = RequestFactory().get("/")
            request.user = user
            return set(model_admin.get_form(request, None).base_fields)

        self.assertFalse(any(name in fields_for(staff) for name in COLS))
        self.assertTrue(all(name in fields_for(self.su) for name in COLS))
        self.assertIn("state", fields_for(staff))

    def test_bulk_import_skips_a_row_the_database_refuses(self):
        def row(email, aadhaar):
            return {"user_fields": {"email": email, "first_name": "Zz", "last_name": "Import"},
                    "profile_fields": {"aadhar_no": aadhaar} if aadhaar else {}}

        self.client.force_login(self.su)
        session = self.client.session
        session["employee_import_rows"] = [
            row("zz_imp1@example.com", "999999999999"),
            row("zz_imp2@example.com", "999999999999"),
            row("zz_imp3@example.com", None),
        ]
        session.save()

            response = self.client.post(reverse("employeeBulkImport"), {"action": "confirm_import"})
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 302)
        emails = set(User.objects.filter(email__startswith="zz_imp").values_list("email", flat=True))
        self.assertEqual(emails, {"zz_imp1@example.com", "zz_imp3@example.com"})


class KeyRotationTests(Base):
    def setUp(self):
        self.old_keys = list(settings.FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEYS)
        self.new_key = Fernet.generate_key().decode()
        self.p = self.make(self.org1, "zz_o@example.com", aadhar_no=AADHAAR_A, pan_no="ABCDE1234F",
                           phone_number=PHONE_A, address="1 Test Street")

    def run_cmd(self, *args):
        out = StringIO()
        call_command("rotate_encryption_keys", *args, stdout=out)
        return out.getvalue()

    def test_dry_run_counts_and_changes_nothing(self):
        before = raw_all()
        with override_settings(FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEYS=[self.new_key] + self.old_keys):
            text = self.run_cmd("--dry-run")
        self.assertIn("DRY RUN TOTAL", text)
        self.assertNotIn("rotated=0 ", text)
        self.assertEqual(raw_all(), before)

    def test_refuses_when_old_key_is_missing(self):
        before = raw_all()
        with override_settings(FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEYS=[self.new_key]):
            with self.assertRaises(CommandError):
                self.run_cmd()
        self.assertEqual(raw_all(), before)

    def test_rotation_keeps_data_and_is_safe_to_repeat(self):
        before_raw = raw_all()
        before = P.objects.get(pk=self.p.pk)
        snapshot = tuple(getattr(before, c) for c in COLS) + (before.aadhar_bidx, before.phone_bidx)
        with override_settings(FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEYS=[self.new_key] + self.old_keys):
            self.run_cmd()
            self.assertNotEqual(raw_all(), before_raw)
            second = self.run_cmd()
        self.assertIn("rotated=0", second)
        with override_settings(FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEYS=[self.new_key]):
            after = P.objects.get(pk=self.p.pk)
            self.assertEqual(tuple(getattr(after, c) for c in COLS) + (after.aadhar_bidx, after.phone_bidx), snapshot)

def user_role(request):
    if not request.user.is_authenticated:
        return {
            "current_org": None,
            "is_admin_role": False,
            "is_manager_role": False,

            "has_employee_profile": False,

            "can_view_hr_dashboard": False,
            "can_manage_employees": False,
            "can_manage_attendance": False,
            "can_review_leave": False,
            "can_manage_leave_balance": False,
            "can_review_attendance_exception": False,
            "can_manage_salary": False,

            # Exit / Clearance
            "can_review_manager_noc": False,
            "can_review_finance_noc": False,
            "can_view_all_clearance_requests": False,
            "can_apply_clearance_for_employee": False,
            "can_initiate_employee_exit": False,
            "can_finalize_employee_exit": False,
        }

    user = request.user

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Existing HRMS permissions
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    can_view_hr_dashboard = (
        user.is_superuser
        or user.has_perm("appEmp.view_hr_dashboard")
    )

    can_manage_employees = (
        user.is_superuser
        or user.has_perm("appEmp.manage_employees")
    )

    can_manage_attendance = (
        user.is_superuser
        or user.has_perm("appEmp.manage_attendance")
    )

    can_review_leave = (
        user.is_superuser
        or user.has_perm("appEmp.review_leave")
    )

    can_manage_leave_balance = (
        user.is_superuser
        or user.has_perm("appEmp.manage_leave_balance")
    )

    can_review_attendance_exception = (
        user.is_superuser
        or user.has_perm(
            "appEmp.review_attendance_exception"
        )
    )

    can_manage_salary = (
        user.is_superuser
        or user.has_perm("appEmp.manage_salary")
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Employee profile
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    has_employee_profile = empProfile.objects.filter(
        user=user,
        is_active=True,
    ).exists()

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Manager Clearance access
    #
    # Manager NOC is object-level:
    # - user has employees reporting to them, OR
    # - a pending Manager NOC is directly assigned to them
    #
    # Superuser can also see the menu.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    current_org = getattr(request, "current_org", None)

    has_direct_reports = (
        current_org is not None
        and empProfile.objects.filter(
            organization=current_org,
            manager__user=user,
            is_active=True,
        ).exists()
    )

    has_pending_manager_noc = (
        current_org is not None
        and ClearanceApproval.objects.filter(
            clearance_request__employee__organization=current_org,
            approval_type="MANAGER_NOC",
            assigned_to=user,
            status="PENDING",
            clearance_request__status="PENDING",
        ).exists()
    )

    can_review_manager_noc = (
        user.is_superuser
        or has_direct_reports
        or has_pending_manager_noc
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Finance Clearance
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    can_review_finance_noc = (
        user.is_superuser
        or user.has_perm(
            "appEmp.review_finance_noc"
        )
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # HR Exit / Clearance permissions
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    can_view_all_clearance_requests = (
        user.is_superuser
        or user.has_perm(
            "appEmp.view_all_clearance_requests"
        )
    )

    can_apply_clearance_for_employee = (
        user.is_superuser
        or user.has_perm(
            "appEmp.apply_clearance_for_employee"
        )
    )

    can_initiate_employee_exit = (
        user.is_superuser
        or user.has_perm(
            "appEmp.initiate_employee_exit"
        )
    )

    can_finalize_employee_exit = (
        user.is_superuser
        or user.has_perm(
            "appEmp.finalize_employee_exit"
        )
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Context
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    home_org = getattr(request, "home_org", None)
    switchable_orgs = []
    is_viewing_other_org = False

    if user.is_superuser:
        from app_organizations.models import Organization

        switchable_orgs = list(Organization.objects.order_by("name"))
        is_viewing_other_org = (
            current_org is not None
            and home_org is not None
            and current_org.pk != home_org.pk
        )

    return {
        "current_org": current_org,
        "home_org": home_org,
        "switchable_orgs": switchable_orgs,
        "is_viewing_other_org": is_viewing_other_org,
        "is_admin_role": can_view_hr_dashboard,

        "is_manager_role": (
            can_review_leave
            or can_review_attendance_exception
            or can_review_manager_noc
        ),

        "has_employee_profile": has_employee_profile,

        "can_view_hr_dashboard": can_view_hr_dashboard,
        "can_manage_employees": can_manage_employees,
        "can_manage_attendance": can_manage_attendance,
        "can_review_leave": can_review_leave,
        "can_manage_leave_balance": can_manage_leave_balance,
        "can_review_attendance_exception": (
            can_review_attendance_exception
        ),
        "can_manage_salary": can_manage_salary,

        # Exit / Clearance
        "can_review_manager_noc": can_review_manager_noc,
        "can_review_finance_noc": can_review_finance_noc,
        "can_view_all_clearance_requests": (
            can_view_all_clearance_requests
        ),
        "can_apply_clearance_for_employee": (
            can_apply_clearance_for_employee
        ),
        "can_initiate_employee_exit": (
            can_initiate_employee_exit
        ),
        "can_finalize_employee_exit": (
            can_finalize_employee_exit
        ),
    }

from django.core.exceptions import FieldDoesNotExist


class OrgColumnMixin:
    """
    Superuser-only admin: show and filter by the owning organization.
    org_path is a lookup such as "organization" or "employee__organization".
    If the path does not exist on the model, nothing is added.
    """

    org_path = "organization"

    def _org_path_valid(self):
        model = self.model
        for part in self.org_path.split("__"):
            try:
                field = model._meta.get_field(part)
            except FieldDoesNotExist:
                return False
            if not field.is_relation:
                return False
            model = field.related_model
        return True

    def get_list_display(self, request):
        cols = list(super().get_list_display(request))
        if self._org_path_valid() and "admin_org" not in cols:
            cols.append("admin_org")
        return cols

    def get_list_filter(self, request):
        flt = list(super().get_list_filter(request))
        if self._org_path_valid() and self.org_path not in flt:
            flt.insert(0, self.org_path)
        return flt

    def admin_org(self, obj):
        for part in self.org_path.split("__"):
            obj = getattr(obj, part, None)
            if obj is None:
                return "-"
        return obj

    admin_org.short_description = "Organization"


@admin.register(empProfile)

class EmployeeAdmin(OrgColumnMixin, admin.ModelAdmin):
    org_path = "organization"
    list_display = (
        "user",
        # "role",
        "designation",
        "shift",
        "manager",
        "is_active",
    )

    list_filter = (
        # "role",
        "is_active",
        "designation",
        "shift",
    )

    search_fields = (
        "user__username",
        "user__first_name",
        "user__last_name",
        "user__email",
    )

    SENSITIVE_FIELDS = (
        "aadhar_no",
        "pan_no",
        "bank_account_no",
        "uan_no",
        "esic_no",
        "phone_number",
        "address",
    )

    def get_exclude(self, request, obj=None):
        exclude = list(super().get_exclude(request, obj) or [])
        if not request.user.is_superuser:
            exclude += list(self.SENSITIVE_FIELDS)
        return exclude

==> ./appEmp/blind_index.py <==
"""
Blind-index helper (Phase 2, step 2.4).

A blind index is a keyed fingerprint of a value (HMAC-SHA256 with
settings.BLIND_INDEX_KEY, a secret separate from the encryption keys). The
same normalised value always gives the same fingerprint, so the database can
check equality and uniqueness without decrypting anything.

Rules:
- The value is cleaned first, so different ways of writing the same number
  give the same fingerprint.
- A label for the field kind is mixed in, so the same digits in two different
  kinds never share a fingerprint.
- Empty values give None (stored as NULL, so a unique rule ignores them).
- Error messages and logs never contain a value or a key.
- Changing BLIND_INDEX_KEY changes every fingerprint. It is a long-lived secret.
"""
import hashlib
import hmac
import re

from django.conf import settings
from django.core.exceptions import ImproperlyConfigured

KIND_AADHAAR = "aadhaar"
KIND_PHONE = "phone"

AADHAAR_DIGITS = 12
PHONE_MATCH_DIGITS = 10

_AADHAAR_ALLOWED = re.compile(r"[\d\s\-]+")
_NON_DIGITS = re.compile(r"\D")


class BlindIndexError(ValueError):
    """A value cannot be fingerprinted. The message never contains the value."""


def _normalize_aadhaar(value):
    text = str(value).strip()
    if not text:
        return None
    if not _AADHAAR_ALLOWED.fullmatch(text):
        raise BlindIndexError("Aadhaar must contain only digits, spaces or dashes.")
    digits = _NON_DIGITS.sub("", text)
    if len(digits) != AADHAAR_DIGITS:
        raise BlindIndexError("Aadhaar must be exactly 12 digits.")
    return digits


def _normalize_phone(value):
    digits = _NON_DIGITS.sub("", str(value))
    if len(digits) < PHONE_MATCH_DIGITS:
        return None
    return digits[-PHONE_MATCH_DIGITS:]


_NORMALIZERS = {
    KIND_AADHAAR: _normalize_aadhaar,
    KIND_PHONE: _normalize_phone,
}


def _get_key():
    key = (getattr(settings, "BLIND_INDEX_KEY", "") or "").strip()
    if len(key) < 32:
        raise ImproperlyConfigured("BLIND_INDEX_KEY is missing or shorter than 32 characters.")
    return key.encode("utf-8")


def blind_index(kind, value):
    """Return the 64-character hex fingerprint of value, or None if it is empty."""
    try:
        normalize = _NORMALIZERS[kind]
    except KeyError:
        raise ValueError("Unsupported blind-index kind.") from None
    if value is None:
        return None
    normalized = normalize(value)
    if not normalized:
        return None
    message = (kind + ":" + normalized).encode("utf-8")
    return hmac.new(_get_key(), message, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()


def aadhaar_index(value):
    return blind_index(KIND_AADHAAR, value)


def phone_index(value):
    return blind_index(KIND_PHONE, value)


def indexes_equal(first, second):
    """Constant-time comparison. Two missing fingerprints are never equal."""
    if not first or not second:
        return False
    return hmac.compare_digest(first, second)

==> ./appEmp/test_phase2_keys.py <==
from decimal import Decimal

from cryptography.fernet import Fernet
from django.db import connection
from django.test.utils import override_settings

from appEmp import test_phase2_encryption as common
from appEmp.fields import FieldDecryptionError
from appEmp.models import Salary
from appEmp.models import empProfile as P


class WrongKeyTests(common.Base):
    def test_wrong_key_gives_a_clear_error_without_the_value(self):
        p = self.make(self.org1, "zz_k1@example.com", pan_no="ABCDE1234F", phone_number=common.PHONE_A)
        with override_settings(FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEYS=[Fernet.generate_key().decode()]):
            with self.assertRaises(FieldDecryptionError) as ctx:
                P.objects.get(pk=p.pk)
        message = str(ctx.exception)
        self.assertNotIn("ABCDE1234F", message)
        self.assertNotIn(common.PHONE_A, message)

    def test_a_plain_value_in_an_encrypted_column_is_refused(self):
        p = self.make(self.org1, "zz_k2@example.com", pan_no="ABCDE1234F")
        with connection.cursor() as cursor:
            cursor.execute('UPDATE "appEmp_empprofile" SET "pan_no" = %s WHERE id = %s', ["ABCDE1234F", p.pk])
        with self.assertRaises(FieldDecryptionError):
            P.objects.get(pk=p.pk)

    def test_salary_read_with_the_wrong_key_is_refused(self):
        profile = self.make(self.org1, "zz_k3@example.com")
        s = Salary.objects.create(employee=profile, basic_salary=Decimal("50000.00"))
        with override_settings(FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEYS=[Fernet.generate_key().decode()]):
            with self.assertRaises(FieldDecryptionError):
                Salary.objects.get(pk=s.pk)

# appEmp/whatsapp_router.py

import re
from appEmp.models import empProfile
from appEmp.blind_index import phone_index
from django.utils import timezone

def normalize_phone(raw: str) -> str:
    """Return the last 10 digits of a phone number, stripped of any
    non-digit characters. Used to match WhatsApp sender numbers
    (e.g. '918886588873') against empProfile.phone_number
    (e.g. '08886588873') regardless of prefix formatting."""
    digits = re.sub(r"\D", "", raw or "")
    return digits[-10:] if len(digits) >= 10 else digits


def find_employee_by_phone(sender_number: str):
    """Returns the matching empProfile, or None if there's no match
    or more than one match (ambiguous phone numbers must never
    resolve to a guess — caller should fall back to needs_human)."""
    target = normalize_phone(sender_number)
    if not target:
        return None

    fingerprint = phone_index(sender_number)
    if not fingerprint:
        return None

    matches = list(empProfile.objects.filter(phone_bidx=fingerprint)[:2])

    if len(matches) == 1:
        return matches[0]

    return None

def get_leave_balance_reply(employee) -> str:
    """
    Build a human-readable leave balance summary for an employee,
    using the current calendar year. Handles employees with zero,
    one, or multiple leave types.
    """
    from datetime import date
    balances = employee.leave_balances.filter(year=date.today().year)

    if not balances.exists():
        return "We couldn't find any leave balance records for you. Please contact HR."

    if balances.count() == 1:
        b = balances.first()
        return f"You have {b.available_balance} day(s) of {b.leave_type} remaining."

    lines = [f"{b.leave_type}: {b.available_balance} day(s)" for b in balances]
    return "Your leave balances:\n" + "\n".join(lines)



CATEGORY_RULES = [
    ("leave", re.compile(r"\bleave\b|\bbalance\b|\bpto\b|\bcasual leave\b|\bsick leave\b", re.I)),
    ("attendance", re.compile(r"\battendance\b|\bpresent\b|\babsent\b|\bcheck.?in\b|\bcheck.?out\b", re.I)),
    ("payroll", re.compile(r"\bsalary\b|\bpayslip\b|\bpay\b|\breimbursement\b", re.I)),
]

def classify_message(message_text: str) -> str:
    """Returns a category string based on keyword rules.
    Falls back to 'general' if nothing matches."""
    for category, pattern in CATEGORY_RULES:
        if pattern.search(message_text or ""):
            return category
    return "general"


def get_attendance_reply(employee) -> str:
    """Reports today's attendance status for the employee."""
    today = timezone.localdate()
    record = employee.attendances.filter(date=today).first()

    if not record:
        return "No attendance has been marked for you today yet."

    if record.check_in and record.check_out:
        return (
            f"Today's status: {record.get_status_display()}. "
            f"Checked in at {record.check_in.strftime('%I:%M %p')}, "
            f"checked out at {record.check_out.strftime('%I:%M %p')}."
        )
    if record.check_in:
        return (
            f"Today's status: {record.get_status_display()}. "
            f"Checked in at {record.check_in.strftime('%I:%M %p')}, no check-out yet."
        )
    return f"Today's status: {record.get_status_display()}."

def get_payroll_reply(employee) -> str:
    """Reports the employee's current net monthly pay only —
    no breakdown of basic/HRA/PF/TDS over WhatsApp."""
    salary = employee.salary_records.filter(is_active=True).first()

    if not salary:
        return "We couldn't find active salary records for you. Please contact HR."

    return f"Your net pay this month is ₹{salary.net_monthly_pay:,.2f}."

DATE_TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r"\d{1,2}[./-]\d{1,2}[./-]\d{4}|\d{4}[./-]\d{1,2}[./-]\d{1,2}")


def _parse_date_cell(raw):
    if raw in (None, ""):
        return None, None
    if isinstance(raw, datetime):
        return raw.date(), None
    if isinstance(raw, date):
        return raw, None

    text = str(raw).strip()
    match = DATE_TOKEN_RE.search(text)
    candidate = match.group(0) if match else text.splitlines()[0].strip()

    for fmt in ("%Y-%m-%d", "%d-%m-%Y", "%d/%m/%Y", "%d.%m.%Y", "%Y.%m.%d"):
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(candidate, fmt).date(), None
        except ValueError:
            continue
    return None, f"Unrecognized date: {raw!r}"


def _clean_import_value(config, raw_value):
    if isinstance(raw_value, float) and raw_value.is_integer():
        raw_value = int(raw_value)

    if config.data_type == "DATE":
        parsed, err = _parse_date_cell(raw_value)
        if err:
            if config.is_required:
                return None, err
            return None, None
        if config.is_required and parsed is None:
            return None, f"{config.display_name} is required."
        return parsed, None

    value = "" if raw_value is None else str(raw_value).strip()

    if config.is_required and not value:
        return None, f"{config.display_name} is required."

    if not value:
        return None, None

    if config.data_type in ("TEXT", "PHONE"):
        return value, None

    if config.data_type == "FULL_NAME":
        parts = value.split(" ", 1)
        return {"first_name": parts[0], "last_name": parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else ""}, None

    if config.data_type == "EMAIL":
        cleaned = value.lower()
        if "@" not in cleaned:
            return None, f"{config.display_name} is not a valid email."
        return cleaned, None

    if config.data_type == "REGEX":
        test_value = re.sub(r"\s+", "", value.splitlines()[0])
        if config.field_key == "pan_no":
            test_value = test_value.upper()
        elif config.field_key == "aadhar_no":
            test_value = re.sub(r"\D", "", test_value)
        if config.validation_regex and not re.match(config.validation_regex, test_value):
            return None, (
                config.validation_message
                or f"{config.display_name} format is invalid ({value!r})."
            )
        return test_value, None

    if config.data_type == "DESIGNATION_FK":
        return value, None

    return value, None

AADHAAR_IN_USE_MESSAGE = (
    "This Aadhaar number is already registered, so this person can't be imported. "
    "Check the number. If it is correct, contact support."
)


def _find_header_row(rows, configs):
    required_labels = {c.column_label.strip().lower() for c in configs if c.is_required}
    for i, row in enumerate(rows[:5]):
        cells = {str(c).strip().lower() for c in row if c is not None}
        if required_labels and required_labels.issubset(cells):
            return i, [str(c).strip() if c is not None else "" for c in row]
    return None, None

@login_required
@permission_required("appEmp.manage_employees", raise_exception=True)
@require_org_role(["owner", "admin"])
def employee_bulk_import_view(request):
    configs = list(
        EmployeeImportFieldConfig.objects.filter(organization=request.current_org, is_active=True).order_by("order")
    )

    preview_rows = []
    has_errors = False
    show_project_column = False
    org = request.current_org
    offer_projects = project_access.can_manage_projects(request.user, org)
    project_by_code = {}
    if offer_projects:
        project_by_code = {
            project.code.upper(): project
            for project in ProjectModel.objects.filter(organization=org)
        }
    ready_count = 0
    skip_count = 0
    warning_count = 0

    # ---------------- CONFIRM ----------------
    if request.method == "POST" and request.POST.get("action") == "confirm_import":
        import_rows = request.session.get("employee_import_rows", [])
        if not import_rows:
            messages.error(request, "No validated employees are available for import.")
            return redirect("employeeBulkImport")

        created_count, skipped_count, project_skipped_count = 0, 0, 0

        project_ids = {r.get("project_id") for r in import_rows if r.get("project_id")}
        valid_project_ids = set()
        if project_ids:
            valid_project_ids = set(
                ProjectModel.objects
                .filter(organization=request.current_org, pk__in=project_ids)
                .exclude(status=ProjectModel.STATUS_ARCHIVED)
                .values_list("pk", flat=True)
            )

        with transaction.atomic():
            for row in import_rows:
                project_id = row.get("project_id")
                if project_id and project_id not in valid_project_ids:
                    project_skipped_count += 1
                    continue

                email = row["user_fields"].get("email")

                if not email or User.objects.filter(email__iexact=email).exists():
                    skipped_count += 1
                    continue

                aadhaar = row["profile_fields"].get("aadhar_no")
                if aadhaar and _aadhaar_unusable(aadhaar):
                    skipped_count += 1
                    continue

                try:
                    with transaction.atomic():
                        user = User(
                            username=email,
                            email=email,
                            first_name=row["user_fields"].get("first_name", ""),
                            last_name=row["user_fields"].get("last_name", ""),
                        )
                        user.set_unusable_password()
                        user._organization = request.current_org
                        user.save()  # signal auto-creates empProfile

                        profile = empProfile.objects.get(user=user)

                        for key, value in row["profile_fields"].items():
                            if key == "designation" and value:
                                designation, _ = DesignationMaster.objects.get_or_create(
                                    name=value,
                                    organization=request.current_org,
                                )
                                profile.designation = designation
                            elif key in ("date_hired", "avsec_training_date", "police_verification_date"):
                                setattr(profile, key, datetime.strptime(value, "%Y-%m-%d").date() if value else None)
                            else:
                                setattr(profile, key, value or None)

                        if project_id:
                            profile.project_id = project_id

                        profile.save()
                except (IntegrityError, ValidationError):
                    skipped_count += 1
                    continue
                created_count += 1

        request.session.pop("employee_import_rows", None)
        messages.success(
            request,
            f"{created_count} employee(s) imported successfully. {skipped_count} duplicate(s) skipped."
        )
        if project_skipped_count:
            messages.warning(
                request,
                f"{project_skipped_count} row(s) skipped because their project is no longer available."
            )
        return redirect("employeeList")

    # ---------------- PREVIEW ----------------
    if request.method == "POST":
        form = EmployeeBulkImportForm(
            request.POST, request.FILES, organization=org, offer_projects=offer_projects
        )

        if form.is_valid():
            uploaded_file = form.cleaned_data["file"]
            default_project = form.cleaned_data.get("default_project")
            try:
                workbook = load_workbook(uploaded_file, data_only=True)
                worksheet = workbook.active
                rows = [list(r) for r in worksheet.iter_rows(values_only=True)]

                header_idx, headers = _find_header_row(rows, configs)

                if header_idx is None:
                    required_labels = ", ".join(c.column_label for c in configs if c.is_required)
                    messages.error(
                        request,
                        f"Could not find the expected header row. Required columns: {required_labels}."
                    )
                else:
                    col_index = {h.strip().lower(): i for i, h in enumerate(headers) if h}
                    project_col = col_index.get("project code")
                    show_project_column = bool(
                        offer_projects and (project_col is not None or default_project is not None)
                    )
                    seen_emails = set()
                    seen_aadhaar = set()

                    for row_number, row in enumerate(rows[header_idx + 1:], start=header_idx + 2):
                        if not any(c is not None and str(c).strip() for c in row):
                            continue

                        row_blocking_errors, row_soft_errors, row_warnings = [], [], []
                        user_fields, profile_fields, display_values = {}, {}, {}

                        for config in configs:
                            idx = col_index.get(config.column_label.strip().lower())
                            raw_value = row[idx] if idx is not None and idx < len(row) else None

                            value, error = _clean_import_value(config, raw_value)

                            if error or isinstance(value, dict):
                                display_values[config.display_name] = raw_value
                            else:
                                display_values[config.display_name] = value

                            if error:
                                if config.is_required:
                                    row_blocking_errors.append(error)
                                else:
                                    row_soft_errors.append(f"{error} -- skipped, row still imported.")
                                continue
                            if value is None:
                                continue

                            if config.data_type == "FULL_NAME":
                                user_fields.update(value)
                            elif config.target_model == "USER":
                                user_fields[config.field_key] = value
                            elif config.data_type == "DATE":
                                profile_fields[config.field_key] = value.isoformat()
                            else:
                                profile_fields[config.field_key] = value

                        project_id = None
                        project_display = ""
                        raw_code = row[project_col] if project_col is not None and project_col < len(row) else None
                        if isinstance(raw_code, float) and raw_code.is_integer():
                            raw_code = int(raw_code)
                        code = "" if raw_code is None else str(raw_code).strip().upper()

                        if code and not offer_projects:
                            row_warnings.append("Project Code ignored -- you cannot assign projects.")
                        elif code:
                            matched = project_by_code.get(code)
                            project_display = code
                            if matched is None:
                                row_blocking_errors.append(f"Unknown project code '{code}'.")
                            elif matched.status == ProjectModel.STATUS_ARCHIVED:
                                row_blocking_errors.append(f"Project '{code}' is archived.")
                            else:
                                project_id = matched.pk
                                project_display = matched.code
                        elif default_project is not None:
                            project_id = default_project.pk
                            project_display = default_project.code

                        email = user_fields.get("email", "")
                        is_duplicate = False

                        if email and not row_blocking_errors:
                            if email in seen_emails:
                                is_duplicate = True
                                row_warnings.append("Duplicate email inside uploaded file -- will be skipped.")
                            elif User.objects.filter(email__iexact=email).exists():
                                is_duplicate = True
                                row_warnings.append("An account with this email already exists -- will be skipped.")
                            else:
                                seen_emails.add(email)

                        aadhaar = profile_fields.get("aadhar_no")
                        if aadhaar and not row_blocking_errors and not is_duplicate:
                            # Deliberately not org-scoped: the number is globally unique,
                            # and the message must not reveal where it is registered.
                            try:
                                aadhaar_fp = aadhaar_index(aadhaar)
                            except BlindIndexError:
                                aadhaar_fp = None
                                row_blocking_errors.append("Aadhaar number is not a valid 12-digit number.")
                            if aadhaar_fp and (aadhaar_fp in seen_aadhaar or empProfile.objects.filter(aadhar_bidx=aadhaar_fp).exists()):
                                is_duplicate = True
                                row_warnings.append(AADHAAR_IN_USE_MESSAGE)
                            else:
                                seen_aadhaar.add(aadhaar_fp)

                        if row_blocking_errors:
                            status = "ERROR"
                            has_errors = True
                        elif is_duplicate:
                            status = "SKIP"
                            skip_count += 1
                        elif row_soft_errors:
                            status = "WARNING"
                            ready_count += 1
                            warning_count += 1
                        else:
                            status = "READY"
                            ready_count += 1

                        preview_rows.append({
                            "row_number": row_number,
                            "display_values": display_values,
                            "errors": row_blocking_errors,
                            "warnings": row_warnings + row_soft_errors,
                            "status": status,
                            "_user_fields": user_fields,
                            "_profile_fields": profile_fields,
                            "_project_id": project_id,
                            "project_display": project_display,
                        })

                    request.session["employee_import_rows"] = [
                        {
                            "user_fields": r["_user_fields"],
                            "profile_fields": r["_profile_fields"],
                            "project_id": r["_project_id"],
                        }
                        for r in preview_rows if r["status"] in ("READY", "WARNING")
                    ]

            except Exception as exc:
                request.session.pop("employee_import_rows", None)
                messages.error(request, f"Could not read the uploaded file: {exc}")
    else:
        form = EmployeeBulkImportForm(organization=org, offer_projects=offer_projects)

    return render(request, "appEmp/employee_bulk_import.html", {
        "form": form, "preview_rows": preview_rows, "configs": configs,
        "show_project_column": show_project_column,
        "has_errors": has_errors, "ready_count": ready_count,
        "skip_count": skip_count, "warning_count": warning_count,
    })

def _aadhaar_unusable(value):
    """
    Bulk-import check: True when the number is malformed or already
    registered. Compared by fingerprint across all organizations, because
    an Aadhaar number is globally unique.
    """
    try:
        fingerprint = aadhaar_index(value)
    except BlindIndexError:
        return True
    return bool(fingerprint) and empProfile.objects.filter(aadhar_bidx=fingerprint).exists()


def _filtered_emp_queryset(request):
    """
    Shared search/filter logic for the employee list — used by both
    the on-screen list view and the PDF export, so they always stay
    in sync.
    """
    search_query = request.GET.get("q", "").strip()
    designation_id = request.GET.get("designation", "").strip()
    shift_id = request.GET.get("shift", "").strip()
    status = request.GET.get("status", "").strip()  # "active" | "inactive" | ""

    objects = empProfile.objects.filter(organization=request.current_org)

    if search_query:
        match = (
            Q(user__first_name__icontains=search_query)
            | Q(user__last_name__icontains=search_query)
        )
        phone_fp = phone_index(search_query)
        if phone_fp:
            match |= Q(phone_bidx=phone_fp)
        objects = objects.filter(match)

    if designation_id:
        objects = objects.filter(designation_id=designation_id)

    if shift_id:
        objects = objects.filter(shift_id=shift_id)

    if status == "active":
        objects = objects.filter(is_active=True)
    elif status == "inactive":
        objects = objects.filter(is_active=False)

    project_ctx = project_filter_context(request)
    objects = apply_project_filter(objects, project_ctx["project_filter_selected"])

    filters = {
        "search_query": search_query,
        "designation_id": designation_id,
        "shift_id": shift_id,
        "status": status,
        "project_ctx": project_ctx,
    }
    return objects, filters

@login_required
def empList_view(request):
    if not user_has_permission(request.user, "manage_employees"):
        messages.error(request, "You don't have permission to view employees.")
        return redirect("dashboard")

    objects, filters = _filtered_emp_queryset(request)

    objects = objects.values(
        "id",
        "user__first_name",
        "user__last_name",
        "phone_number",
        "uuid",
    )

    designations = DesignationMaster.objects.filter(
        organization=request.current_org, is_active=True
    ).order_by("name")
    shifts = ShiftMaster.objects.filter(
        organization=request.current_org
    ).order_by("name")

    return render(
        request,
        "appEmp/empList.html",
        {
            "objects": objects,
            "search_query": filters["search_query"],
            "designations": designations,
            "shifts": shifts,
            "selected_designation": filters["designation_id"],
            "selected_shift": filters["shift_id"],
            "selected_status": filters["status"],
            **filters["project_ctx"],
        },
    )


@login_required
def empList_pdf_view(request):
    if not user_has_permission(request.user, "manage_employees"):
        messages.error(request, "You don't have permission to view employees.")
        return redirect("dashboard")

    objects, _ = _filtered_emp_queryset(request)
    objects = objects.select_related("designation", "shift").order_by(
        "user__first_name", "user__last_name"
    )

    buffer = BytesIO()
    doc = SimpleDocTemplate(
        buffer, pagesize=A4,
        topMargin=15 * mm, bottomMargin=15 * mm,
        leftMargin=12 * mm, rightMargin=12 * mm,
    )
    styles = getSampleStyleSheet()
    elements = []

    NAVY = colors.HexColor('#0F172A')
    GRID = colors.HexColor('#CBD5E1')

    title_style = ParagraphStyle('ListTitle', parent=styles['Heading1'], textColor=NAVY, spaceAfter=2)
    elements.append(Paragraph("Employee List", title_style))
    elements.append(
        Paragraph(
            f"Generated on {timezone.now().strftime('%d %b %Y, %I:%M %p')} "
            f"&mdash; {objects.count()} record(s)",
            styles['Normal'],
        )
    )
    elements.append(Spacer(1, 6 * mm))

    data = [['ID', 'Name', 'Phone Number', 'Designation', 'Status']]
    for profile in objects:
        name = profile.user.get_full_name() or profile.user.username
        data.append([
            str(profile.id),
            name,
            profile.phone_number or '—',
            profile.designation.name if profile.designation else '—',
            'Active' if profile.is_active else 'Inactive',
        ])

    table = Table(data, colWidths=[15 * mm, 55 * mm, 35 * mm, 50 * mm, 25 * mm], repeatRows=1)
    table.setStyle(TableStyle([
        ('BACKGROUND', (0, 0), (-1, 0), NAVY),
        ('TEXTCOLOR', (0, 0), (-1, 0), colors.white),
        ('FONTNAME', (0, 0), (-1, 0), 'Helvetica-Bold'),
        ('FONTSIZE', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 9),
        ('GRID', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.5, GRID),
        ('BOTTOMPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 5),
        ('TOPPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 5),
        ('ROWBACKGROUNDS', (0, 1), (-1, -1), [colors.white, colors.HexColor('#F8FAFC')]),
    ]))
    elements.append(table)

    doc.build(elements)
    buffer.seek(0)

    response = HttpResponse(buffer, content_type='application/pdf')
    filename = f"employee_list_{timezone.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M')}.pdf"
    response['Content-Disposition'] = f'attachment; filename="{filename}"'
    return response
# Fields to exclude from "verification" stats even though they're
# is_-prefixed booleans on empProfile (employment status flags,
# not verification checks).
VERIFICATION_FIELD_EXCLUDE = {"is_active", "is_default_manager"}


def _get_verification_fields():
    """
    Dynamically discovers verification-status boolean fields on
    empProfile, so adding a new field like `is_pan_verified` to the
    model automatically shows up here — no code change needed.
    """
    fields = []
    for field in empProfile._meta.get_fields():
        if getattr(field, "get_internal_type", None) is None:
            continue
        if field.get_internal_type() != "BooleanField":
            continue
        if not field.name.startswith("is_"):
            continue
        if field.name in VERIFICATION_FIELD_EXCLUDE:
            continue

        label = field.name[3:].replace("_", " ").title()
        fields.append((field.name, label))

    return fields


@login_required
def verificationStats_view(request):
    if not user_has_permission(request.user, "manage_employees"):
        messages.error(request, "You don't have permission to view this page.")
        return redirect("dashboard")

    verification_fields = _get_verification_fields()

    profiles = empProfile.objects.filter(
        organization=request.current_org,
        is_active=True,
    ).select_related("user")
    total = profiles.count()

    stat_cards = []
    for field_name, label in verification_fields:
        verified_count = profiles.filter(**{field_name: True}).count()
        percent = round((verified_count / total) * 100) if total else 0
        stat_cards.append({
            "label": label,
            "verified_count": verified_count,
            "total": total,
            "percent": percent,
        })

    filter_status = request.GET.get("status", "all")  # all | incomplete | complete

    rows = []
    for profile in profiles.order_by("user__first_name", "user__last_name"):
        flags = {field_name: getattr(profile, field_name) for field_name, _ in verification_fields}
        is_fully_verified = all(flags.values())

        if filter_status == "incomplete" and is_fully_verified:
            continue
        if filter_status == "complete" and not is_fully_verified:
            continue

        rows.append({
            "profile": profile,
            "flags": flags,
            "is_fully_verified": is_fully_verified,
        })

    fully_verified_count = sum(
        1 for p in profiles
        if all(getattr(p, f) for f, _ in verification_fields)
    )

    return render(
        request,
        "appEmp/verificationStats.html",
        {
            "stat_cards": stat_cards,
            "rows": rows,
            "total": total,
            "fully_verified_count": fully_verified_count,
            "filter_status": filter_status,
            "verification_fields": verification_fields,
        },
    )

@login_required
def verification_quick_update_view(request, uuid):
    if not user_has_permission(request.user, "manage_employees"):
        messages.error(request, "You don't have permission to update verification status.")
        return redirect("dashboard")

    if request.method != "POST":
        raise PermissionDenied("Verification updates must be submitted securely.")

    profile = get_object_or_404(
        empProfile,
        uuid=uuid,
        organization=request.current_org,
    )
    verification_fields = _get_verification_fields()

    changed_fields = []
    for field_name, _ in verification_fields:
        new_value = field_name in request.POST
        if getattr(profile, field_name) != new_value:
            setattr(profile, field_name, new_value)
            changed_fields.append(field_name)

    if changed_fields:
        profile.save(update_fields=changed_fields + ["updated_at"])
        messages.success(
            request,
            f"Verification status updated for {profile.user.get_full_name() or profile.user.username}."
        )
    else:
        messages.info(request, "No changes were made.")

    next_url = request.POST.get("next")
    if next_url and next_url.startswith("/"):
        return redirect(next_url)

    return redirect("verificationStats")

@login_required
def profileDetail_view(request, uuid):
    logged_in_profile = get_object_or_404(
        empProfile,
        user=request.user
    )

    employee = get_object_or_404(
        empProfile.objects.select_related(
            "user",
            "manager__user",
            "designation",
            "shift",
        ),
        uuid=uuid,
        organization=request.current_org,
    )

    is_admin = user_has_permission(request.user, "manage_employees")
    is_direct_manager = employee.manager_id == logged_in_profile.id

    if not is_admin and not is_direct_manager:
        messages.error(
            request,
            "You don't have permission to edit this employee profile."
        )
        return redirect("dashboard")

    if request.method == "POST":
        form = ProfileFormAdmin(
            request.POST,
            instance=employee,
            request_user=request.user,
        )

        if form.is_valid():
            form.save()

            messages.success(
                request,
                "Profile updated successfully."
            )

            return redirect(
                "editProfile",
                uuid=employee.uuid
            )
    else:
        form = ProfileFormAdmin(
            instance=employee,
            request_user=request.user,
        )

    target_salary = employee.salary_records.filter(
        is_active=True
    ).first()

    return render(
        request,
        "appEmp/profile.html",
        {
            "employee": employee,
            "profile": employee,
            "form": form,
            "salary": target_salary,
            "can_edit_salary": user_has_permission(request.user, "manage_salary"),
            "can_edit_profile": True,
            "salary_form": SalaryForm(
                instance=target_salary
            ),
            "target_uuid": employee.uuid,
            "current_year": timezone.now().year,
            "current_month": timezone.now().month,
            "document_form": empDocumentForm(org=request.current_org),
            "documents": employee.documents.all(),
        },
    )


@login_required
def empProfile_view(request):
    from app_organizations.models import OrganizationMember

    membership = (
        OrganizationMember.objects
        .filter(user=request.user)
        .select_related("organization")
        .order_by("id")
        .first()
    )
    if membership is None:
        messages.error(request, "Your account is not part of any organization.")
        return redirect("dashboard")

    profile, created = empProfile.objects.get_or_create(
        user=request.user,
        defaults={"organization": membership.organization},
    )
    if request.method == "POST":
        form = EmployeeForm(request.POST, instance=profile)
        if form.is_valid():
            form.save()
            messages.success(request, "Profile updated successfully.")
            return redirect("myProfile")
    else:
        form = EmployeeForm(instance=profile)

    self_salary = profile.salary_records.filter(is_active=True).first()

    return render(
        request,
        "appEmp/profile.html",
        {
            "form": form,
            "profile": profile,
            "created": created,
            "salary": self_salary,
            "can_edit_salary": False,
            "target_uuid": profile.uuid,
            "current_year": timezone.now().year,
            "current_month": timezone.now().month,
        },
    )

    # =========================================================

    # =========================================================
