@login_required
def holiday_year_view(request):
    today = timezone.localdate()

    try:
        year = int(
            request.GET.get("year", today.year)
        )
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        year = today.year

    months = _build_holiday_year(request.current_org, year)

    default_month = (
        today.month
        if year == today.year
        else 1
    )

    return render(

            "year": year,
            "months": months,
            "previous_year": year - 1,
            "next_year": year + 1,
            "default_month": default_month,
        },
    )

@login_required
@permission_required("appEmp.manage_employees", raise_exception=True) 
def holiday_bulk_upload_view(request):
    preview_rows = []
    has_errors = False
    ready_count = 0
    skip_count = 0

    # --------------------------------------------------
    # FINAL IMPORT
    # --------------------------------------------------
    if (
        request.method == "POST"
        and request.POST.get("action") == "confirm_import"
    ):
        import_rows = request.session.get(
            "holiday_import_rows",
            []
        )

        if not import_rows:
            messages.error(
                request,
                "No validated holidays are available for import."
            )
            return redirect("holidayBulkUpload")

        imported_count = 0
        skipped_count = 0

        with transaction.atomic():

            for row in import_rows:
                name = row["name"]
                holiday_date = datetime.strptime(
                    row["date"],
                    "%Y-%m-%d",
                ).date()

                # Safety check in case record was added
                # after preview but before confirmation.
                existing = Holiday.objects.filter(
                    organization=request.current_org,
                    name__iexact=name,
                    date=holiday_date,
                ).exists()

                if existing:
                    skipped_count += 1
                    continue

                Holiday.objects.create(
                    organization=request.current_org,
                    name=name,
                    date=holiday_date,
                    holiday_type=row["holiday_type"],
                    description=row.get(
                        "description",
                        "",
                    ),
                    is_active=True,
                    created_by=request.user,
                )

                imported_count += 1

        request.session.pop(
            "holiday_import_rows",
            None,
        )

        messages.success(
            request,
            f"{imported_count} holiday(s) imported successfully. "
            f"{skipped_count} duplicate(s) skipped."
        )

        return redirect("holidayList")

    # --------------------------------------------------
    # FILE VALIDATION / PREVIEW
    # --------------------------------------------------
    if request.method == "POST":

        form = HolidayBulkUploadForm(
            request.POST,
            request.FILES,
        )

        if form.is_valid():

            uploaded_file = form.cleaned_data[
                "file"
            ]

            try:
                rows = []

                # ============================
                # XLSX
                # ============================
                if uploaded_file.name.lower().endswith(
                    ".xlsx"
                ):

                    workbook = load_workbook(
                        uploaded_file,
                        data_only=True,
                    )

                    worksheet = workbook.active

                    for row in worksheet.iter_rows(
                        values_only=True
                    ):
                        rows.append(list(row))

                # ============================
                # CSV
                # ============================
                elif uploaded_file.name.lower().endswith(
                    ".csv"
                ):

                    uploaded_file.seek(0)

                    decoded_file = (
                        uploaded_file
                        .read()
                        .decode("utf-8-sig")
                    )

                    reader = csv.reader(
                        io.StringIO(decoded_file)
                    )

                    rows = list(reader)

                # ============================
                # EMPTY FILE
                # ============================
                if not rows:

                    messages.error(
                        request,
                        "The uploaded file is empty."
                    )

                else:

                    expected_headers = [
                        "Holiday Name",
                        "Date",
                        "Type",
                        "Description",
                    ]

                    headers = [
                        str(value).strip()
                        if value is not None
                        else ""
                        for value in rows[0][:4]
                    ]

                    # ============================
                    # HEADER VALIDATION
                    # ============================
                    if headers != expected_headers:

                        messages.error(
                            request,
                            "Invalid file format. "
                            "Expected columns: Holiday Name, "
                            "Date, Type, Description."
                        )

                    else:

                        valid_import_rows = []

                        # Prevent duplicates inside
                        # the uploaded file itself.
                        seen_upload_rows = set()

                        for row_number, row in enumerate(
                            rows[1:],
                            start=2,
                        ):

                            # Ignore empty Excel rows
                            if not any(
                                value is not None
                                and str(value).strip()
                                for value in row
                            ):
                                continue

                            # -----------------------
                            # Values
                            # -----------------------
                            name = (
                                str(row[0]).strip()
                                if len(row) > 0
                                and row[0] is not None
                                else ""
                            )

                            raw_date = (
                                row[1]
                                if len(row) > 1
                                else None
                            )

                            holiday_type = (
                                str(row[2])
                                .strip()
                                .upper()
                                if len(row) > 2
                                and row[2] is not None
                                else ""
                            )

                            description = (
                                str(row[3]).strip()
                                if len(row) > 3
                                and row[3] is not None
                                else ""
                            )

                            errors = []
                            warnings = []

                            holiday_date = None

                            # ============================
                            # NAME
                            # ============================
                            if not name:
                                errors.append(
                                    "Holiday name is required."
                                )

                            # ============================
                            # DATE
                            # ============================
                            if isinstance(
                                raw_date,
                                datetime,
                            ):
                                holiday_date = (
                                    raw_date.date()
                                )

                            elif isinstance(
                                raw_date,
                                date,
                            ):
                                holiday_date = raw_date

                            elif raw_date:

                                raw_date_string = str(
                                    raw_date
                                ).strip()

                                accepted_formats = [
                                    "%Y-%m-%d",
                                    "%d-%m-%Y",
                                    "%d/%m/%Y",
                                ]

                                for date_format in (
                                    accepted_formats
                                ):
                                    try:

                                        holiday_date = (
                                            datetime.strptime(
                                                raw_date_string,
                                                date_format,
                                            ).date()
                                        )

                                        break

                                    except ValueError:
                                        continue

                            if not holiday_date:
                                errors.append(
                                    "Invalid date."
                                )

                            # ============================
                            # TYPE
                            # ============================
                            if holiday_type not in [
                                "MANDATORY",
                                "OPTIONAL",
                            ]:
                                errors.append(
                                    "Type must be MANDATORY "
                                    "or OPTIONAL."
                                )

                            # ============================
                            # DUPLICATE CHECK
                            # ============================
                            is_duplicate = False

                            if (
                                name
                                and holiday_date
                                and not errors
                            ):

                                duplicate_key = (
                                    name.lower(),
                                    holiday_date.isoformat(),
                                )

                                # Duplicate inside Excel
                                if duplicate_key in (
                                    seen_upload_rows
                                ):
                                    is_duplicate = True

                                    warnings.append(
                                        "Duplicate inside uploaded "
                                        "file — will be skipped."
                                    )

                                else:
                                    seen_upload_rows.add(
                                        duplicate_key
                                    )

                                    # Duplicate already DB
                                    if Holiday.objects.filter(
                                        organization=request.current_org,
                                        name__iexact=name,
                                        date=holiday_date,
                                    ).exists():

                                        is_duplicate = True

                                        warnings.append(
                                            "Holiday already exists "
                                            "— will be skipped."
                                        )

                            # ============================
                            # STATUS
                            # ============================
                            if errors:
                                status = "ERROR"
                                has_errors = True

                            elif is_duplicate:
                                status = "SKIP"
                                skip_count += 1

                            else:
                                status = "READY"
                                ready_count += 1

                                valid_import_rows.append({
                                    "name": name,
                                    "date": (
                                        holiday_date
                                        .isoformat()
                                    ),
                                    "holiday_type": (
                                        holiday_type
                                    ),
                                    "description": (
                                        description
                                    ),
                                })

                            preview_rows.append({
                                "row_number": row_number,
                                "name": name,
                                "date": holiday_date,
                                "holiday_type": (
                                    holiday_type
                                ),
                                "description": description,
                                "errors": errors,
                                "warnings": warnings,
                                "status": status,
                            })

                        # Invalid row means we don't
                        # allow confirmation.
                        if has_errors:
                            request.session.pop(
                                "holiday_import_rows",
                                None,
                            )

                        else:
                            request.session[
                                "holiday_import_rows"
                            ] = valid_import_rows

            except Exception as exc:

                request.session.pop(
                    "holiday_import_rows",
                    None,
                )

                messages.error(
                    request,
                    f"Could not read the uploaded file: {exc}"
                )

    else:
        form = HolidayBulkUploadForm()

    return render(
        request,
        "appEmp/holiday_bulk_upload.html",
        {
            "form": form,
            "preview_rows": preview_rows,
            "has_errors": has_errors,
            "ready_count": ready_count,
            "skip_count": skip_count,
        },
    )

@login_required
def review_optional_holiday_request_view(request, uuid):
    if not can_review_leave(request.user):
        messages.error(
            request,
            "You don't have permission to review this request."
        )
        return redirect("dashboard")

    optional_request = get_object_or_404(
        OptionalHolidayRequest.objects.select_related(
            "employee__user",
            "holiday",
        ),
        uuid=uuid,
        employee__organization=request.current_org,
    )

    if optional_request.status != "PENDING":
        messages.info(
            request,
            "This request has already been reviewed."
        )
        return redirect(
            "pendingOptionalHolidayRequests"
        )

    if request.method == "POST":
        action = request.POST.get("action")

        if action not in ["approve", "reject"]:
            messages.error(
                request,
                "Invalid review action."
            )
            return redirect(
                "pendingOptionalHolidayRequests"
            )

        optional_request.status = (
            "APPROVED"
            if action == "approve"
            else "REJECTED"
        )

        optional_request.reviewed_by = request.user
        optional_request.reviewed_at = timezone.now()

        optional_request.save(
            update_fields=[
                "status",
                "reviewed_by",
                "reviewed_at",
                "updated_at",
            ]
        )

        messages.success(
            request,
            (
                f"Optional holiday request "
                f"{optional_request.status.lower()} successfully."
            )
        )

    return redirect(
        "pendingOptionalHolidayRequests"
    )



@login_required
def upload_document(request):
    employee = empProfile.objects.filter(user=request.user).first()
    if employee is None:
        messages.error(request, "Your account has no employee profile.")
        return redirect("dashboard")
    can_upload_for_others = request.user.has_perm("appEmp.manage_employees")

    FormClass = HrDocumentUploadForm if can_upload_for_others else empDocumentForm

    if request.method == "POST":
        form = FormClass(request.POST, request.FILES, org=request.current_org)
        if form.is_valid():
            doc = form.save(commit=False)
            doc.employee = form.cleaned_data["employee"] if can_upload_for_others else employee
            doc.save()
            _add_compression_message(request, form)
            return redirect("upload_document")
    else:
        form = FormClass(org=request.current_org)

    documents = employee.documents.all()

    return render(request, "appEmp/upload_document.html", {
        "form": form,
        "documents": documents,
        "can_upload_for_others": can_upload_for_others,
    })

@login_required
@permission_required("appEmp.manage_employees", raise_exception=True)
def hr_document_list(request):
    documents = empDocument.objects.select_related(
        "employee__user", "document_type"
    ).filter(employee__organization=request.current_org)

    selected_type = request.GET.get("document_type", "")
    selected_status = request.GET.get("is_verified", "")

    if selected_type:
        documents = documents.filter(document_type_id=selected_type)

    if selected_status in ("true", "false"):
        documents = documents.filter(is_verified=(selected_status == "true"))

    document_types = DocumentTypeMaster.objects.filter(
        organization=request.current_org, is_active=True
    )

    return render(request, "appEmp/hr_document_list.html", {
        "documents": documents,
        "document_types": document_types,
        "selected_type": selected_type,
        "selected_status": selected_status,
    })


@login_required
@permission_required("appEmp.manage_employees", raise_exception=True)
def hr_verify_document(request, doc_id):
    document = get_object_or_404(
        empDocument,
        id=doc_id,
        employee__organization=request.current_org,
    )

    if request.method == "POST":
        document.is_verified = True
        document.is_rejected = False
        document.rejection_reason = None
        document.reviewed_by = request.user
        document.reviewed_at = timezone.now()
        document.save()

        messages.success(request, "Document verified successfully.")

    return redirect("hr_document_list")


@login_required
@permission_required("appEmp.manage_employees", raise_exception=True)
def hr_reject_document(request, doc_id):
    document = get_object_or_404(
        empDocument,
        id=doc_id,
        employee__organization=request.current_org,
    )

    if request.method == "POST":
        document.is_verified = False
        document.is_rejected = True
        document.rejection_reason = request.POST.get("rejection_reason", "").strip() or None
        document.reviewed_by = request.user
        document.reviewed_at = timezone.now()
        document.save()

        messages.info(request, "Document rejected.")

    return redirect("hr_document_list")


@login_required
def profile_document_upload(request, uuid):
    profile = get_object_or_404(
        empProfile,
        uuid=uuid,
        organization=request.current_org,
    )

    is_self = hasattr(request.user, "empprofile") and request.user.empprofile.id == profile.id
    can_manage = request.user.has_perm("appEmp.manage_employees")

    if not (is_self or can_manage):
        raise PermissionDenied

    if request.method == "POST":
        form = empDocumentForm(request.POST, request.FILES, org=request.current_org)
        if form.is_valid():
            doc = form.save(commit=False)
            doc.employee = profile
            doc.save()
            _add_compression_message(request, form)
            messages.success(request, "Document uploaded successfully.")
            messages.success(request, "Document uploaded successfully.")
        else:
            for field, errors in form.errors.items():
                for error in errors:
                    messages.error(request, f"{field}: {error}")

    return redirect("editProfile", uuid=profile.uuid)

        )

        employee__organization=request.current_org,

        and attendance.check_in_longitude is not None
    )

    has_checkout_location = (
        attendance.check_out_latitude is not None
        and attendance.check_out_longitude is not None
    )

    return render(
        request,
        "appEmp/attendance_location.html",
        {
            "attendance": attendance,
            "has_location": has_location,
            "has_checkout_location": has_checkout_location,
        },
    )

@csrf_exempt
def whatsapp_webhook(request):
    if request.method == 'GET':
        mode = request.GET.get('hub.mode')
        token = request.GET.get('hub.verify_token')
        challenge = request.GET.get('hub.challenge')

        if mode == 'subscribe' and token == settings.WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN:
            return HttpResponse(challenge, status=200)
        return HttpResponse('Verification failed', status=403)

    if request.method == 'POST':
        data = json.loads(request.body)

        try:
            entry = data['entry'][0]
            changes = entry['changes'][0]['value']

            if 'messages' not in changes:
                return JsonResponse({'status': 'ignored'}, status=200)

            message = changes['messages'][0]
            contact = changes['contacts'][0]

            wa_message_id = message['id']
            sender_wa_id = message['from']
            sender_name = contact.get('profile', {}).get('name', '')
            message_body = message.get('text', {}).get('body', '')

            category = classify_message(message_body)

            ticket, created = WhatsAppTicket.objects.get_or_create(
                wa_message_id=wa_message_id,
                defaults={
                    'sender_wa_id': sender_wa_id,
                    'sender_name': sender_name,
                    'message_body': message_body,
                    'category': category,
                }
            )

            if created:
                reply_text = None

                if category == "leave":
                    employee = find_employee_by_phone(sender_wa_id)
                    if employee:
                        reply_text = get_leave_balance_reply(employee)
                        ticket.status = "auto_resolved"
                        ticket.save(update_fields=["status"])

                elif category == "attendance":
                    employee = find_employee_by_phone(sender_wa_id)
                    if employee:
                        reply_text = get_attendance_reply(employee)
                        ticket.status = "auto_resolved"
                        ticket.save(update_fields=["status"])

                elif category == "payroll":
                    employee = find_employee_by_phone(sender_wa_id)
                    if employee:
                        reply_text = get_payroll_reply(employee)
                        ticket.status = "auto_resolved"
                        ticket.save(update_fields=["status"])

                if not reply_text:
                    reply_text = f"Thanks {sender_name or ''}, we've logged your message as ticket #{ticket.id}. Our HR team will get back to you."

                send_whatsapp_message(sender_wa_id, reply_text)

        except (KeyError, IndexError):
            pass

        return JsonResponse({'status': 'ok'}, status=200)

def _bcas_pass_status_counts(passes_qs):
    """
    Computes stat-card counts in Python since status is a derived
    property, not a DB field. Cheap enough for typical pass volumes;
    revisit with DB-level annotation if this ever needs to scale up.
    """
    counts = {
        "total": 0, "active": 0, "expiring_30d": 0,
        "police_pending": 0, "expired": 0, "suspended": 0,
    }
    for bcas_pass in passes_qs:
        counts["total"] += 1
        status = bcas_pass.status
        if status == "ACTIVE":
            counts["active"] += 1
            if bcas_pass.is_expiring_soon:
                counts["expiring_30d"] += 1
        elif status == "EXPIRED":
            counts["expired"] += 1
        elif status == "SUSPENDED":
            counts["suspended"] += 1
        if bcas_pass.police_verification_pending:
            counts["police_pending"] += 1
    return counts


@login_required
def bcas_pass_dashboard_view(request):
    if not user_has_permission(request.user, "manage_employees"):
        messages.error(request, "You don't have permission to view BCAS passes.")
        return redirect("dashboard")

    passes = (
        BCASPass.objects
        .select_related("employee__user", "airport")
        .filter(employee__organization=request.current_org)
    )

    # ── Filters ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    pass_type = request.GET.get("pass_type", "")
    status_filter = request.GET.get("status", "")
    state_filter = request.GET.get("state", "")
    search = request.GET.get("search", "").strip()

    if pass_type:
        passes = passes.filter(pass_type=pass_type)

    if state_filter:
        passes = passes.filter(airport__state=state_filter)

    if search:
        passes = passes.filter(
            Q(employee__user__first_name__icontains=search)
            | Q(employee__user__last_name__icontains=search)
            | Q(uuid__icontains=search)
        )

    # Compute counts BEFORE the status filter, so cards reflect the
    # full filtered-by-other-fields set, not the status-narrowed set.
    stat_counts = _bcas_pass_status_counts(passes)

    if status_filter:
        passes = [p for p in passes if p.status == status_filter]
    else:
        passes = list(passes)

    passes.sort(key=lambda p: p.created_at, reverse=True)

    states = (
        Airport.objects
        .filter(is_active=True)
        .values_list("state", flat=True)
        .distinct()
        .order_by("state")
    )

    # ── State-wise summary ──────────────────────────────────
    state_summary = {}
    for bcas_pass in BCASPass.objects.select_related("airport").filter(
        employee__organization=request.current_org
    ):
        state = bcas_pass.airport.state
        state_summary.setdefault(state, {"total": 0, "active": 0})
        state_summary[state]["total"] += 1
        if bcas_pass.status == "ACTIVE":
            state_summary[state]["active"] += 1

    return render(
        request,
        "appEmp/bcas_pass_dashboard.html",
        {
            "passes": passes,
            "stat_counts": stat_counts,
            "states": states,
            "state_summary": state_summary,
            "pass_type_choices": BCASPass._meta.get_field("pass_type").choices,
            "selected_pass_type": pass_type,
            "selected_status": status_filter,
            "selected_state": state_filter,
            "search": search,
            "form": BCASPassForm(org=request.current_org),
        },
    )


@login_required
def bcas_pass_issue_view(request):
    if not user_has_permission(request.user, "manage_employees"):
        messages.error(request, "You don't have permission to issue BCAS passes.")
        return redirect("dashboard")

    if request.method == "POST":
        form = BCASPassForm(request.POST, org=request.current_org)
        if form.is_valid():
            bcas_pass = form.save(commit=False)
            bcas_pass.created_by = request.user
            bcas_pass.save()
            messages.success(
                request,
                f"BCAS pass issued for {bcas_pass.employee}."
            )
        else:
            messages.error(request, "Please correct the errors in the form.")

    return redirect("bcasPassDashboard")


@login_required
def bcas_pass_status_update_view(request, uuid):
    if not user_has_permission(request.user, "manage_employees"):
        messages.error(request, "You don't have permission to update BCAS passes.")
        return redirect("dashboard")

    bcas_pass = get_object_or_404(
        BCASPass,
        uuid=uuid,
        employee__organization=request.current_org,
    )

    if request.method == "POST":
        action = request.POST.get("action")

        if action == "reactivate":
            bcas_pass.manual_status = None
            bcas_pass.save(update_fields=["manual_status", "updated_at"])
            messages.success(request, f"Pass reactivated for {bcas_pass.employee}.")
        else:
            form = BCASPassStatusForm(request.POST, instance=bcas_pass)
            if form.is_valid():
                form.save()
                messages.success(
                    request,
                    f"Pass status updated for {bcas_pass.employee}."
                )
            else:
                messages.error(request, "Please correct the errors in the form.")

    return redirect("bcasPassDashboard")


@login_required
def bcas_pass_export_csv_view(request):
    if not user_has_permission(request.user, "manage_employees"):
        messages.error(request, "You don't have permission to export BCAS passes.")
        return redirect("dashboard")

    passes = BCASPass.objects.select_related(
        "employee__user", "airport"
    ).filter(employee__organization=request.current_org)

    response = HttpResponse(content_type="text/csv")
    response["Content-Disposition"] = 'attachment; filename="bcas_passes.csv"'

    writer = csv.writer(response)
    writer.writerow([
        "Employee", "Pass Type", "Airport", "State", "Issue Date",
        "Expiry Date", "Access Zones", "Issuing Authority", "Status",
        "Police Verification Pending",
    ])

    for bcas_pass in passes:
        writer.writerow([
            str(bcas_pass.employee),
            bcas_pass.get_pass_type_display(),
            bcas_pass.airport.name,
            bcas_pass.airport.state,
            bcas_pass.issue_date,
            bcas_pass.expiry_date,
            bcas_pass.access_zones,
            bcas_pass.issuing_authority,
            bcas_pass.status,
            "Yes" if bcas_pass.police_verification_pending else "No",
        ])

    return response

def _mandatory_holiday_count(org, year, month):
    month_start = date(year, month, 1)
    month_end = date(year, month, calendar.monthrange(year, month)[1])
    return Holiday.objects.filter(
        organization=org,
        is_active=True, holiday_type="MANDATORY",
        date__gte=month_start, date__lte=month_end,
    ).count()


@login_required
def wage_register_bulk_view(request, year, month):
    if not user_has_permission(request.user, "manage_salary"):
        messages.error(request, "You don't have permission to do this.")
        return redirect("dashboard")

    wage_month = date(year, month, 1)
    daily_wage_salaries = Salary.objects.filter(
        is_active=True, wage_type="DAILY",
        employee__organization=request.current_org,
    )
    project_ctx = project_filter_context(request)
    daily_wage_salaries = apply_project_filter(
        daily_wage_salaries,
        project_ctx["project_filter_selected"],
        path="employee__project",
    )
    daily_wage_salaries = daily_wage_salaries.select_related(
        "employee", "employee__user"
    ).order_by("employee__user__first_name", "employee__user__last_name", "pk")

    existing_entries = {
        e.salary_id: e
        for e in WageRegisterEntry.objects.filter(
            salary__in=daily_wage_salaries, wage_month=wage_month
        )
    }

    if request.method == "POST":
        formset = WageRegisterFormSet(request.POST)
        if formset.is_valid():
            with transaction.atomic():
                for form in formset:
                    cd = form.cleaned_data
                    salary = get_object_or_404(
                        Salary,
                        pk=cd["salary_id"],
                        employee__organization=request.current_org,
                    )
                    WageRegisterEntry.objects.update_or_create(
                        salary=salary,
                        wage_month=wage_month,
                        defaults={
                            "rate_override": cd.get("rate_override"),
                            "national_holidays_in_month": cd.get("national_holidays_in_month") or 0,
                            "days_worked_override": cd.get("days_worked_override"),
                            "ot_hours_override": cd.get("ot_hours_override"),
                            "mode_of_payment": cd.get("mode_of_payment") or "",
                            "payment_date": cd.get("payment_date"),
                            "created_by": request.user,
                        },
                    )
            messages.success(
                request, f"Wage register saved for {wage_month.strftime('%B %Y')}."
            )
            return redirect("wageRegisterBulk", year=year, month=month)
        else:
            messages.error(request, "Please correct the errors below.")
    else:
        default_nh = _mandatory_holiday_count(request.current_org, year, month)
        initial = []
        for salary in daily_wage_salaries:
            existing = existing_entries.get(salary.pk)
            initial.append({
                "salary_id": salary.pk,
                "rate_override": existing.rate_override if existing else None,
                "national_holidays_in_month": (
                    existing.national_holidays_in_month if existing else default_nh
                ),
                "days_worked_override": existing.days_worked_override if existing else None,
                "ot_hours_override": existing.ot_hours_override if existing else None,
                "mode_of_payment": existing.mode_of_payment if existing else "",
                "payment_date": existing.payment_date if existing else None,
            })
        formset = WageRegisterFormSet(initial=initial)

    rows = []
    for form, salary in zip(formset, daily_wage_salaries):
        existing = existing_entries.get(salary.pk)
        preview = existing or WageRegisterEntry(salary=salary, wage_month=wage_month)
        rows.append({"form": form, "salary": salary, "preview": preview})

    totals = {
        "gross": sum((r["preview"].gross_total for r in rows), Decimal("0")),
        "deductions": sum((r["preview"].total_deduction for r in rows), Decimal("0")),
        "net": sum((r["preview"].net_payment for r in rows), Decimal("0")),
    }

    return render(request, "appEmp/wageRegisterBulk.html", {
        "formset": formset,
        "rows": rows,
        "wage_month": wage_month,
        "year": year,
        "month": month,
        "totals": totals,
        **project_ctx,
    })

from django.db.models import Count, Q

from app_projects.models import Action, Project
from appEmp.models import empProfile


def project_overview(org, today):
    people = {
        r["project"]: r["n"]
        for r in empProfile.objects.filter(organization=org, is_active=True)
        .values("project")
        .order_by()
        .annotate(n=Count("id"))
    }
    work = {
        r["project"]: r
        for r in Action.objects.filter(
            organization=org, status__in=Action.OPEN_STATUSES
        )
        .values("project")
        .order_by()
        .annotate(
            open=Count("id"),
            overdue=Count("id", filter=Q(due_date__lt=today)),
        )
    }
    rows = []
    for p in (
        Project.objects.filter(organization=org)
        .exclude(status=Project.STATUS_ARCHIVED)
        .order_by("name")
    ):
        rows.append({
            "name": p.name,
            "uuid": p.uuid,
            "people": people.get(p.pk, 0),
            "open": work.get(p.pk, {}).get("open", 0),
            "overdue": work.get(p.pk, {}).get("overdue", 0),
        })
    return {"rows": rows, "unassigned": people.get(None, 0)}

files** and **comments inside the files** to reflect the new version number and

* Updated:
```xml

```

## Adding a new icon

1. Use only [Font Awesome Free Icons](https://fontawesome.com/icons).
2. Save the icon as an .svg file in this directory.
3. Include the following attribution comment at the top of the file (do not
   change it):
```xml

```
4. Right before the `<path>` element, add the following metadata comment with
   the appropriate values:
```xml
<!--
  Icon Name: [icon-name]
  Icon Family: [classic | sharp | brands | etc.]
  Icon Style: [solid | regular | light | thin | duotone | etc.]
-->
```

                ('created_at', models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)),

            ],
            options={
                'ordering': ['created_at', 'id'],
            },
        ),
        migrations.AddIndex(
            model_name='action',
            index=models.Index(fields=['project', 'status'], name='action_project_status_idx'),
        ),
        migrations.AddIndex(
            model_name='action',
            index=models.Index(fields=['assignee', 'status'], name='action_assignee_status_idx'),
        ),
        migrations.AddConstraint(
            model_name='action',
            constraint=models.CheckConstraint(condition=models.Q(('parent__isnull', True), models.Q(('pk', models.F('parent')), _negated=True), _connector='OR'), name='action_parent_not_self'),

==> ./app_projects/services.py <==
"""
Rules for actions (tasks) inside a project.

Views call these functions and never change an action directly. Each one
checks who may do it, checks the data, and writes an ActionEvent.
PermissionDenied means "you may not"; ValidationError means "that is invalid".
"""

import io
import os
import zipfile

from django.core.exceptions import PermissionDenied, ValidationError
from django.core.files.base import ContentFile
from django.db import transaction
from django.db.models import Q
from django.utils import timezone

from appEmp.models import empProfile

from .access import can_manage_projects
from .models import Action, ActionAttachment, ActionComment, ActionEvent

TITLE_MAX = 200
EDITABLE_FIELDS = ("title", "description", "due_date")


def _own_profile_id(user, org):
    return (
        empProfile.objects
        .filter(user=user, organization=org, is_active=True)
        .values_list("pk", flat=True)
        .first()
    )


def _require_manager(actor, org):
    if not can_manage_projects(actor, org):
        raise PermissionDenied("You may not manage actions in this project.")


def can_change_status(actor, action):
    if can_manage_projects(actor, action.organization):
        return True
    return bool(
        action.assignee_id
        and action.assignee_id == _own_profile_id(actor, action.organization)
    )


def _require_writable(project):
    if project.is_archived:
        raise ValidationError("This project is archived, so its actions are read-only.")


def _clean_title(title):
    title = (title or "").strip()
    if not title:
        raise ValidationError({"title": "A title is required."})
    if len(title) > TITLE_MAX:
        raise ValidationError({"title": "The title is too long (200 characters at most)."})
    return title


def validate_assignee(project, assignee):
    """The assignee must be an active person on this project, same organization."""
    if assignee.organization_id != project.organization_id:
        raise ValidationError({"assignee": "The assignee must belong to the same organization."})
    if assignee.project_id != project.pk:
        raise ValidationError({"assignee": "The assignee must be on this project's team."})
    if not assignee.is_active:
        raise ValidationError({"assignee": "The assignee is not active."})


def _lock(action):
    return (
        Action.objects
        .select_for_update(of=("self",))
        .select_related("project", "organization")
        .get(pk=action.pk)
    )


def _event(action, actor, kind, from_value="", to_value=""):
    ActionEvent.objects.create(
        action=action,
        actor=actor if getattr(actor, "is_authenticated", False) else None,
        kind=kind,
        from_value=str(from_value or ""),
        to_value=str(to_value or ""),
    )


@transaction.atomic
def create_action(*, project, actor, title, description="", assignee=None,
                  due_date=None, parent=None):
    _require_manager(actor, project.organization)
    _require_writable(project)
    title = _clean_title(title)
    if assignee is not None:
        validate_assignee(project, assignee)
    action = Action.objects.create(
        organization=project.organization,
        project=project,
        parent=parent,
        title=title,
        description=description or "",
        assignee=assignee,
        due_date=due_date,
        created_by=actor if getattr(actor, "is_authenticated", False) else None,
    )
    _event(action, actor, ActionEvent.KIND_CREATED, "", action.status)
    return action


@transaction.atomic
def update_action(action, actor, **changes):
    unknown = set(changes) - set(EDITABLE_FIELDS)
    if unknown:
        raise ValidationError("Cannot edit: %s." % ", ".join(sorted(unknown)))
    action = _lock(action)
    _require_manager(actor, action.organization)
    _require_writable(action.project)
    changed = []
    for field, value in changes.items():
        if field == "title":
            value = _clean_title(value)
        if field == "description":
            value = value or ""
        if getattr(action, field) != value:
            setattr(action, field, value)
            changed.append(field)
    if changed:
        action.save()
        _event(action, actor, ActionEvent.KIND_EDITED, "", ",".join(changed))
    return action


@transaction.atomic
def reassign(action, assignee, actor):
    """Set a new assignee, or None to unassign on purpose."""
    action = _lock(action)
    _require_manager(actor, action.organization)
    _require_writable(action.project)
    if assignee is not None:
        validate_assignee(action.project, assignee)
    new_id = assignee.pk if assignee is not None else None
    if new_id == action.assignee_id:
        return action
    old_id = action.assignee_id
    action.assignee = assignee
    action.save(update_fields=["assignee", "updated_at"])
    _event(action, actor, ActionEvent.KIND_ASSIGNEE, old_id, new_id)
    return action


@transaction.atomic
def change_status(action, new_status, actor):
    """The only way status changes."""
    if not isinstance(new_status, str) or new_status not in dict(Action.STATUS_CHOICES):
        raise ValidationError({"status": "Choose a valid status."})
    action = _lock(action)
    if not can_change_status(actor, action):
        raise PermissionDenied("Only the assignee or a project manager can change the status.")
    _require_writable(action.project)
    old = action.status
    if old == new_status:
        return action
    action.status = new_status
    action.completed_at = timezone.now() if new_status == Action.STATUS_DONE else None
    action.save(update_fields=["status", "completed_at", "updated_at"])
    _event(action, actor, ActionEvent.KIND_STATUS, old, new_status)
    return action


@transaction.atomic
def delete_action(action, actor):
    action = _lock(action)
    _require_manager(actor, action.organization)
    _require_writable(action.project)
    action.delete()


def actions_needing_reassign(project):
    """Open actions whose assignee left the project or was deactivated."""
    return (
        Action.objects
        .filter(project=project, status__in=Action.OPEN_STATUSES, assignee__isnull=False)
        .filter(~Q(assignee__project=project) | Q(assignee__is_active=False))
    )


COMMENT_MAX = 5000
ATTACH_MAX_BYTES = 200 * 1024
ATTACH_MAX_PER_ACTION = 20
ZIP_MAX_UNCOMPRESSED = 20 * 1024 * 1024
ATTACH_TYPES = {
    ".pdf": "application/pdf",
    ".jpg": "image/jpeg",
    ".jpeg": "image/jpeg",
    ".png": "image/png",
    ".docx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
}


def _require_member(actor, org):
    if not (can_manage_projects(actor, org) or _own_profile_id(actor, org)):
        raise PermissionDenied("You are not part of this organization.")


def _lock_child(model, obj):
    return (
        model.objects
        .select_for_update(of=("self",))
        .select_related("action__project", "organization")
        .get(pk=obj.pk)
    )


def _clean_comment(body):
    body = (body or "").strip()
    if not body:
        raise ValidationError({"body": "Write something first."})
    if len(body) > COMMENT_MAX:
        raise ValidationError({"body": "The comment is too long (5000 characters at most)."})
    return body


def _is_owner_or_manager(actor, org, owner_id):
    if can_manage_projects(actor, org):
        return True
    return bool(owner_id and owner_id == getattr(actor, "pk", None))


def can_modify_comment(actor, comment):
    return _is_owner_or_manager(actor, comment.organization, comment.author_id)


def can_delete_attachment(actor, attachment):
    return _is_owner_or_manager(actor, attachment.organization, attachment.uploaded_by_id)


@transaction.atomic
def add_comment(action, actor, body):
    action = _lock(action)
    _require_member(actor, action.organization)
    _require_writable(action.project)
    return ActionComment.objects.create(
        action=action,
        organization=action.organization,
        author=actor if getattr(actor, "is_authenticated", False) else None,
        body=_clean_comment(body),
    )


@transaction.atomic
def update_comment(comment, actor, body):
    comment = _lock_child(ActionComment, comment)
    if not can_modify_comment(actor, comment):
        raise PermissionDenied("Only the author or a project manager can change this comment.")
    _require_writable(comment.action.project)
    comment.body = _clean_comment(body)
    comment.edited_at = timezone.now()
    comment.save(update_fields=["body", "edited_at"])
    return comment


@transaction.atomic
def delete_comment(comment, actor):
    comment = _lock_child(ActionComment, comment)
    if not can_modify_comment(actor, comment):
        raise PermissionDenied("Only the author or a project manager can delete this comment.")
    _require_writable(comment.action.project)
    comment.delete()


def _signature_ok(ext, data):
    if ext == ".pdf":
        return data.startswith(b"%PDF-")
    if ext == ".png":
        return data.startswith(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n")
    if ext in (".jpg", ".jpeg"):
        return data.startswith(b"\xff\xd8\xff")
    if ext == ".docx":
        try:
            with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data)) as z:
                infos = z.infolist()
                names = [i.filename for i in infos]
                if sum(i.file_size for i in infos) > ZIP_MAX_UNCOMPRESSED:
                    return False
                return "[Content_Types].xml" in names and any(
                    n.startswith("word/") for n in names
                )
        except (zipfile.BadZipFile, zipfile.LargeZipFile, OSError):
            return False
    return False


def _validate_upload(upload):
    if upload is None:
        raise ValidationError({"file": "Choose a file to upload."})
    name = os.path.basename((upload.name or "").replace("\\", "/")).strip()
    name = "".join(ch for ch in name if ch.isprintable())
    ext = os.path.splitext(name)[1].lower()
    if ext not in ATTACH_TYPES:
        raise ValidationError({"file": "Only pdf, jpg, png and docx files are allowed."})
    if upload.size > ATTACH_MAX_BYTES:
        raise ValidationError({"file": "The file is too large (200 KB at most)."})
    upload.seek(0)
    data = upload.read(ATTACH_MAX_BYTES + 1)
    if not data:
        raise ValidationError({"file": "The file is empty."})
    if len(data) > ATTACH_MAX_BYTES:
        raise ValidationError({"file": "The file is too large (200 KB at most)."})
    if not _signature_ok(ext, data):
        raise ValidationError({"file": "The file content does not match its type."})
    if len(name) > 200:
        name = name[: 200 - len(ext)] + ext
    return name, ext, data


@transaction.atomic
def add_attachment(action, actor, upload):
    action = _lock(action)
    _require_member(actor, action.organization)
    _require_writable(action.project)
    name, ext, data = _validate_upload(upload)
    if action.attachments.count() >= ATTACH_MAX_PER_ACTION:
        raise ValidationError({"file": "This action already has 20 attachments."})
    att = ActionAttachment(
        action=action,
        organization=action.organization,
        uploaded_by=actor if getattr(actor, "is_authenticated", False) else None,
        original_name=name,
        content_type=ATTACH_TYPES[ext],
        size=len(data),
    )
    att.file.save(name, ContentFile(data), save=False)
    try:
        att.save()
    except Exception:
        att.file.delete(save=False)
        raise
    return att


@transaction.atomic
def delete_attachment(attachment, actor):
    attachment = _lock_child(ActionAttachment, attachment)
    if not can_delete_attachment(actor, attachment):
        raise PermissionDenied("Only the uploader or a project manager can delete this file.")
    _require_writable(attachment.action.project)
    attachment.delete()

from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from django.test import RequestFactory
from django.urls import reverse

from app_projects.context_processors import project_nav
from app_projects.models import Project
from app_projects.test_views import ViewBase
from appEmp.models import empProfile as P


class AssignBase(ViewBase):
    @property
    def url(self):
        return reverse("projectAssign")

    def emp(self, org, email, first="Zz", last="Test", project=None, active=True):
        fields = {"project": project} if project is not None else {}
        profile = self.make(org, email, **fields)
        User.objects.filter(pk=profile.user_id).update(first_name=first, last_name=last)
        if not active:
            P.objects.filter(pk=profile.pk).update(is_active=False)
        return P.objects.get(pk=profile.pk)

    def manager(self):
        return self.person(self.org1, "zz_amgr@example.com", role="manager")

    def member(self):
        return self.person(self.org1, "zz_amem@example.com", project=self.pa)

    def switched_superuser(self):
        self.client.force_login(self.su)
        session = self.client.session
        session["switched_org_id"] = self.org1.id
        session.save()

    def post(self, employees, target, follow=False, **extra):
        data = {"employees": [str(e.uuid) for e in employees], "target": str(target)}
        data.update(extra)
        return self.client.post(self.url, data, follow=follow)

    def project_of(self, employee):
        return P.objects.get(pk=employee.pk).project_id


class AssignAccessTests(AssignBase):
    def test_anonymous_is_redirected(self):

    def test_switched_superuser_gets_200(self):

class AssignListTests(AssignBase):
    def test_lists_only_active_people_of_the_current_organization(self):

        self.login(self.owner())
        response = self.client.get(self.url)
        self.assertContains(response, "Unnamed employee")
        self.assertNotContains(response, "zz_secret2@example.com")

        self.emp(self.org1, "zz_s2@example.com", first="Dave", last="Ddd")
        self.login(self.owner())
        response = self.client.get(self.url, {"q": "alice"})
        self.assertContains(response, "Alice")
        self.assertNotContains(response, "Dave")
        response = self.client.get(self.url, {"q": "alice aaa"})
        self.assertContains(response, "Alice")
        response = self.client.get(self.url, {"q": "aaa dave"})
        self.assertNotContains(response, "Alice")
        self.assertNotContains(response, "Dave")

    def test_unassigned_filter(self):
        self.emp(self.org1, "zz_u1@example.com", first="Alice", last="Aaa")
        self.emp(self.org1, "zz_u2@example.com", first="Bruno", last="Bbb", project=self.pa)
        self.login(self.owner())
        response = self.client.get(self.url, {"project": "unassigned"})
        self.assertContains(response, "Alice")
        self.assertNotContains(response, "Bruno")

    def test_project_filter(self):
        self.emp(self.org1, "zz_p1@example.com", first="Alice", last="Aaa")

        self.assertEqual(Project.objects.get(pk=self.pa.pk).lead_id, e.pk)

import re
import uuid

from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError
from django.core.validators import RegexValidator
from django.db import models
from django.db.models.functions import Lower
from django.conf import settings
from django.core.files.storage import FileSystemStorage
from django.db import transaction
from django.db.models.signals import post_delete
from django.dispatch import receiver

class Project(models.Model):
    STATUS_ACTIVE = "active"
    STATUS_ON_HOLD = "on_hold"
    STATUS_ARCHIVED = "archived"
    STATUS_CHOICES = [
        (STATUS_ACTIVE, "Active"),
        (STATUS_ON_HOLD, "On hold"),
        (STATUS_ARCHIVED, "Archived"),
    ]

    uuid = models.UUIDField(default=uuid.uuid4, unique=True, editable=False)

    organization = models.ForeignKey(
        "app_organizations.Organization",
        on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name="projects",
    )
    name = models.CharField(max_length=150)
    code = models.CharField(
        max_length=20,
        validators=[
            RegexValidator(
                r"^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$",
                "Use only letters, digits, hyphen and underscore.",
            )
        ],
        help_text="Short code, for example PRY. Stored in upper case.",
    )
    description = models.TextField(blank=True)
    status = models.CharField(
        max_length=20, choices=STATUS_CHOICES, default=STATUS_ACTIVE
    )
    lead = models.ForeignKey(
        "appEmp.empProfile",
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        related_name="led_projects",
    )
    start_date = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    end_date = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ["name"]
        permissions = [
            ("view_all_projects", "Can view all projects in the organization"),
            ("manage_projects", "Can create, edit and archive projects"),
        ]
        constraints = [
            models.UniqueConstraint(
                Lower("name"),
                "organization",
                name="uniq_project_name_per_org_ci",
            ),
            models.UniqueConstraint(
                fields=["organization", "code"],
                name="uniq_project_code_per_org",
            ),
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=(
                    models.Q(start_date__isnull=True)
                    | models.Q(end_date__isnull=True)
                    | models.Q(end_date__gte=models.F("start_date"))
                ),
                name="project_end_not_before_start",
            ),
        ]

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.name} ({self.code})"

    @property
    def is_archived(self):
        return self.status == self.STATUS_ARCHIVED

    def _normalize(self):
        self.name = (self.name or "").strip()
        self.code = (self.code or "").strip().upper()

    def _check_lead(self):
        if (
            self.lead_id
            and self.organization_id
            and self.lead.organization_id != self.organization_id
        ):
            raise ValidationError(
                {"lead": "The project lead must belong to the same organization."}
            )

    def clean(self):
        super().clean()
        self._normalize()
        if self.start_date and self.end_date and self.end_date < self.start_date:
            raise ValidationError(
                {"end_date": "End date cannot be before the start date."}
            )
        self._check_lead()

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        self._normalize()
        self._check_lead()
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

    def archive(self):
        self.status = self.STATUS_ARCHIVED
        self.save(update_fields=["status", "updated_at"])


class Action(models.Model):
    STATUS_TODO = "todo"
    STATUS_IN_PROGRESS = "in_progress"
    STATUS_REVIEW = "review"
    STATUS_DONE = "done"
    STATUS_CANCELLED = "cancelled"
    STATUS_CHOICES = [
        (STATUS_TODO, "To do"),
        (STATUS_IN_PROGRESS, "In progress"),
        (STATUS_REVIEW, "Review"),
        (STATUS_DONE, "Done"),
        (STATUS_CANCELLED, "Cancelled"),
    ]
    OPEN_STATUSES = (STATUS_TODO, STATUS_IN_PROGRESS, STATUS_REVIEW)

    uuid = models.UUIDField(default=uuid.uuid4, unique=True, editable=False)

    organization = models.ForeignKey(
        "app_organizations.Organization",
        on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name="actions",
    )
    project = models.ForeignKey(
        Project, on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="actions"
    )
    parent = models.ForeignKey(
        "self",
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        related_name="subtasks",
    )
    title = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    description = EncryptedTextField(blank=True)
    assignee = models.ForeignKey(
        "appEmp.empProfile",
        on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        related_name="assigned_actions",
    )
    status = models.CharField(
        max_length=20, choices=STATUS_CHOICES, default=STATUS_TODO
    )
    due_date = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    created_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL,
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        related_name="+",
    )
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)
    completed_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ["-created_at"]
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=["project", "status"], name="action_project_status_idx"),
            models.Index(fields=["assignee", "status"], name="action_assignee_status_idx"),
        ]
        constraints = [
            models.CheckConstraint(
                condition=models.Q(parent__isnull=True)
                | ~models.Q(pk=models.F("parent")),
                name="action_parent_not_self",
            ),
        ]

    def __str__(self):
        return self.title

    @property
    def is_open(self):
        return self.status in self.OPEN_STATUSES

    @property
    def is_subtask(self):
        return self.parent_id is not None

    @property
    def needs_reassign(self):
        """True when the assignee left the project or was deactivated."""
        if not self.is_open or not self.assignee_id:
            return False
        person = self.assignee
        return (not person.is_active) or person.project_id != self.project_id

    def _check_consistency(self):
        errors = {}
        if self.project_id:
            if not self.organization_id:
                self.organization_id = self.project.organization_id
            elif self.project.organization_id != self.organization_id:
                errors["project"] = "The project belongs to a different organization."
        if (
            self.assignee_id
            and self.organization_id
            and self.assignee.organization_id != self.organization_id
        ):
            errors["assignee"] = "The assignee must belong to the same organization."
        if self.parent_id:
            parent = self.parent
            if self.pk and parent.pk == self.pk:
                errors["parent"] = "An action cannot be its own parent."
            elif parent.project_id != self.project_id:
                errors["parent"] = "A subtask must be in the same project as its parent."
            elif parent.parent_id:
                errors["parent"] = "Subtasks can only be one level deep."
            elif self.pk and self.subtasks.exists():
                errors["parent"] = "An action that has subtasks cannot become a subtask."
        if errors:
            raise ValidationError(errors)

    def clean(self):
        super().clean()
        self.title = (self.title or "").strip()
        self._check_consistency()

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        self.title = (self.title or "").strip()
        self._check_consistency()
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)


class ActionEvent(models.Model):
    KIND_CREATED = "created"
    KIND_STATUS = "status"
    KIND_ASSIGNEE = "assignee"
    KIND_EDITED = "edited"
    KIND_CHOICES = [
        (KIND_CREATED, "Created"),
        (KIND_STATUS, "Status changed"),
        (KIND_ASSIGNEE, "Assignee changed"),
        (KIND_EDITED, "Edited"),
    ]

    action = models.ForeignKey(
        Action, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="events"
    )
    actor = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL,
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        related_name="+",
    )
    kind = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=KIND_CHOICES)
    from_value = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True)
    to_value = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ["created_at", "id"]


class PrivateStorage(FileSystemStorage):
    @property
    def base_location(self):
        return settings.PRIVATE_MEDIA_ROOT

    @property
    def location(self):
        return os.path.abspath(self.base_location)


def get_private_storage():
    return PrivateStorage()


def action_attachment_path(instance, filename):
    ext = os.path.splitext(filename)[1].lower()[:10]
    return "org_%s/actions/%s/%s%s" % (
        instance.organization_id, instance.action.uuid, uuid.uuid4().hex, ext
    )

class ActionAttachment(models.Model):
    uuid = models.UUIDField(default=uuid.uuid4, unique=True, editable=False)
    organization = models.ForeignKey(
        "app_organizations.Organization",
        on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name="+",
    )
    action = models.ForeignKey(
        Action, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="attachments"
    )
    uploaded_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL,
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        related_name="+",
    )
    file = models.FileField(
        upload_to=action_attachment_path,
        storage=get_private_storage,
        max_length=255,
    )
    original_name = models.CharField(max_length=255)
    content_type = models.CharField(max_length=100)
    size = models.PositiveIntegerField()
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ["created_at", "id"]


@receiver(post_delete, sender=ActionAttachment)
def remove_attachment_file(sender, instance, **kwargs):
    name = instance.file.name
    storage = instance.file.storage
    if name:
        transaction.on_commit(lambda: storage.delete(name))

from django.db import connection

class ActionViewBase(ViewBase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.admin = self.person(self.org1, "zz_vadmin@example.com", role="admin")
        self.worker = self.person(self.org1, "zz_vworker@example.com", project=self.pa)
        self.mate = self.person(self.org1, "zz_vmate@example.com", project=self.pa)
        self.beta_user = self.person(self.org1, "zz_vbeta@example.com", project=self.pb)
        self.outsider = self.person(
            self.org2, "zz_voutsider@example.com", role="admin", project=self.pc
        )
        self.worker_p = empProfile.objects.get(user=self.worker)
        self.mate_p = empProfile.objects.get(user=self.mate)
        self.beta_p = empProfile.objects.get(user=self.beta_user)
        self.outsider_p = empProfile.objects.get(user=self.outsider)

        self.a1 = services.create_action(
            project=self.pa, actor=self.admin, title="Alpha task",
            description="Secret text", assignee=self.worker_p,
        )
        self.a2 = services.create_action(
            project=self.pa, actor=self.admin, title="Beta chore"
        )
        self.sub = services.create_action(
            project=self.pa, actor=self.admin, title="Sub item", parent=self.a1
        )

    def list_url(self, project=None):
        return reverse("projectActionList", args=[(project or self.pa).uuid])

    def detail_url(self, action, project=None):
        return reverse("projectActionDetail", args=[(project or self.pa).uuid, action.uuid])

    def edit_url(self, action, project=None):
        return reverse("projectActionEdit", args=[(project or self.pa).uuid, action.uuid])

    def create_url(self, project=None):
        return reverse("projectActionCreate", args=[(project or self.pa).uuid])

        )

    def test_assignee_filter(self):

        self.assertContains(r, "Alpha task")
        self.assertNotContains(r, "Beta chore")
        r = self.client.get(self.list_url(), {"assignee": "unassigned"})
        self.assertContains(r, "Beta chore")
        self.assertNotContains(r, "Alpha task")

    def test_title_search_but_not_description_search(self):

        self.assertNotContains(r, "Alpha task")

    def test_archived_project_has_no_add_button(self):
        self.pa.archive()

        r = self.client.get(self.list_url())
        self.assertEqual(r.status_code, 200)
        self.assertNotContains(r, "Add action")

    def test_query_count_does_not_grow_with_rows(self):
        self.login(self.admin)
        self.client.get(self.list_url())

        def count():
            with CaptureQueriesContext(connection) as ctx:
                self.assertEqual(self.client.get(self.list_url()).status_code, 200)
            return len(ctx)

        before = count()
        for i in range(5):
            services.create_action(
                project=self.pa, actor=self.admin, title="Extra %d" % i,
                assignee=self.worker_p,
            )
        self.assertEqual(count(), before)

class LeaveFilterBase(ViewBase):
    def setUp(self):

            is_superuser=True, is_staff=True

        session.save()

        )
        self.in_a = self.make(self.org1, "zz_la@example.com", project=self.pa)
        self.in_b = self.make(self.org1, "zz_lb@example.com", project=self.pb)
        self.loose = self.make(self.org1, "zz_lx@example.com")

        today = date.today()

            )
            for emp in (self.in_a, self.in_b, self.loose)
        ]

    def found(self, url_name, **params):
        response = self.client.get(reverse(url_name), params)
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        uuids = {leave.uuid for leave in response.context["leave_requests"]}

class ReviewerFilterTests(LeaveFilterBase):
    SCREENS = ("pendingLeaveRequests", "allLeaveRequests")

    def test_dropdown_shown(self):
        for name in self.SCREENS:
            response, _ = self.found(name)
            self.assertTrue(response.context["project_filter_show"], name)

    def test_no_filter_shows_everyone(self):
        for name in self.SCREENS:
            _, uuids = self.found(name)
            self.assertEqual(
                uuids, {self.req_a.uuid, self.req_b.uuid, self.req_x.uuid}, name
            )

    def test_filter_by_project(self):
        for name in self.SCREENS:
            _, uuids = self.found(name, project=str(self.pa.uuid))
            self.assertEqual(uuids, {self.req_a.uuid}, name)

    def test_filter_unassigned(self):
        for name in self.SCREENS:
            _, uuids = self.found(name, project="unassigned")
            self.assertEqual(uuids, {self.req_x.uuid}, name)

    def test_archived_project_still_filters(self):
        Project.objects.filter(pk=self.pb.pk).update(status=Project.STATUS_ARCHIVED)
        for name in self.SCREENS:
            _, uuids = self.found(name, project=str(self.pb.uuid))
            self.assertEqual(uuids, {self.req_b.uuid}, name)

            self.assertEqual(response.context["project_filter_selected"], "", name)
            self.assertEqual(
                uuids, {self.req_a.uuid, self.req_b.uuid, self.req_x.uuid}, name
            )

    def test_project_filter_combines_with_status_filter(self):
        LeaveRequest.objects.filter(pk=self.req_a.pk).update(status="APPROVED")
        _, uuids = self.found(
            "allLeaveRequests", project=str(self.pa.uuid), status="PENDING"
        )
        self.assertEqual(uuids, set())
        _, uuids = self.found(
            "allLeaveRequests", project=str(self.pa.uuid), status="APPROVED"
        )
        self.assertEqual(uuids, {self.req_a.uuid})

import datetime

from django.utils import timezone

from app_projects.models import Action

class ProjectOverviewTests(ActionViewBase):
    def overview(self, org=None):
        return project_overview(org or self.pa.organization, timezone.localdate())

    def row(self, data, name):
        return next(r for r in data["rows"] if r["name"] == name)

    def test_only_own_org_projects(self):
        names = {r["name"] for r in self.overview()["rows"]}
        self.assertIn(self.pa.name, names)
        self.assertNotIn(self.pc.name, names)

    def test_people_and_open_counts(self):
        expected = empProfile.objects.filter(project=self.pa, is_active=True).count()
        row = self.row(self.overview(), self.pa.name)
        self.assertEqual(row["people"], expected)
        self.assertEqual(row["open"], 3)
        self.assertEqual(row["overdue"], 0)

    def test_overdue_counted_and_done_ignored(self):
        past = timezone.localdate() - datetime.timedelta(days=3)
        Action.objects.filter(pk=self.a2.pk).update(due_date=past)
        self.assertEqual(self.row(self.overview(), self.pa.name)["overdue"], 1)
        Action.objects.filter(pk=self.a2.pk).update(status=Action.STATUS_DONE)
        row = self.row(self.overview(), self.pa.name)
        self.assertEqual(row["overdue"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(row["open"], 2)

    def test_archived_project_is_hidden(self):
        self.pb.archive()
        names = {r["name"] for r in self.overview()["rows"]}
        self.assertNotIn(self.pb.name, names)

    def test_unassigned_people_counted(self):
        self.assertGreaterEqual(self.overview()["unassigned"], 1)

==> ./app_projects/access.py <==
"""
Who may see and manage projects.

Rules (the same as Lite):
- Owner, admin and manager see every project in the current organization
  and may create, edit and archive them.
- Anyone else sees only the project on their own employee profile.
- A superuser sees every project of the organization they are working in.

The same abilities can also be granted through the Django permissions
view_all_projects and manage_projects (for example to a new role's group).
A permission only counts inside the user's own organization.
"""

from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError
from django.http import Http404
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404

from app_organizations.models import OrganizationMember
from appEmp.models import empProfile

from .models import Project

VIEW_ALL_ROLES = ("owner", "admin", "manager")
MANAGE_ROLES = ("owner", "admin", "manager")


def _role_in(user, org):
    if org is None or not getattr(user, "is_authenticated", False):
        return None
    return (
        OrganizationMember.objects
        .filter(user=user, organization=org)
        .values_list("role", flat=True)
        .first()
    )


def _allowed(user, org, roles, codename):
    if not getattr(user, "is_authenticated", False):
        return False
    if user.is_superuser:
        return org is not None
    role = _role_in(user, org)
    if role is None:
        return False
    return role in roles or user.has_perm("app_projects." + codename)


def can_view_all_projects(user, org):
    return _allowed(user, org, VIEW_ALL_ROLES, "view_all_projects")


def can_manage_projects(user, org):
    return _allowed(user, org, MANAGE_ROLES, "manage_projects")


def visible_projects(request):
    """Projects the current user may see inside request.current_org."""
    org = getattr(request, "current_org", None)
    user = getattr(request, "user", None)
    if org is None or user is None or not user.is_authenticated:
        return Project.objects.none()

    projects = Project.objects.filter(organization=org)
    if can_view_all_projects(user, org):
        return projects

    project_id = (
        empProfile.objects
        .filter(user=user, organization=org, is_active=True)
        .values_list("project_id", flat=True)
        .first()
    )
    if project_id:
        return projects.filter(pk=project_id)
    return projects.none()


def get_visible_project_or_404(request, project_uuid):
    """A project the user cannot see is a 404, so its existence is not revealed."""
    try:
        return get_object_or_404(visible_projects(request), uuid=project_uuid)
    except (ValueError, ValidationError):
        raise Http404("No project matches the given query.")

==> ./app_projects/management/commands/sync_project_permissions.py <==
from django.contrib.auth.models import Group, Permission
from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand, CommandError

from app_organizations.seed import ORG_ADMIN_GROUP, ORG_ADMIN_PROJECT_PERMISSIONS

TARGET_GROUPS = (ORG_ADMIN_GROUP, "HR_ADMIN")


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Add the project permissions to the ORG_ADMIN and HR_ADMIN groups. "
        "Only adds, never removes, and is safe to run again."
    )

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        perms = list(
            Permission.objects.filter(
                content_type__app_label="app_projects",
                codename__in=ORG_ADMIN_PROJECT_PERMISSIONS,
            )
        )
        if len(perms) != len(ORG_ADMIN_PROJECT_PERMISSIONS):
            raise CommandError("Project permissions are missing. Run migrate first.")

        perm_ids = [p.pk for p in perms]
        for name in TARGET_GROUPS:
            group = Group.objects.filter(name=name).first()
            if group is None:
                self.stdout.write(name + ": group not found, skipped")
                continue
            before = group.permissions.filter(pk__in=perm_ids).count()
            group.permissions.add(*perms)
            self.stdout.write(
                name + ": " + str(len(perms) - before) + " added, "
                + str(before) + " already present"
            )

from django import forms
from django.db.models import Q

from appEmp.models import empProfile

from .models import Project


class LeadChoiceField(forms.ModelChoiceField):
    def label_from_instance(self, obj):
        return obj.user.get_full_name() or obj.user.username


class ProjectForm(forms.ModelForm):
    lead = LeadChoiceField(
        queryset=empProfile.objects.none(), required=False, empty_label="No lead"
    )

    class Meta:
        model = Project
        fields = ["name", "code", "description", "status", "lead", "start_date", "end_date"]
        widgets = {
            "name": forms.TextInput(attrs={"class": "form-control"}),
            "code": forms.TextInput(attrs={"class": "form-control", "placeholder": "e.g. PRY"}),
            "description": forms.Textarea(attrs={"class": "form-control", "rows": 3}),
            "status": forms.Select(attrs={"class": "form-select"}),
            "start_date": forms.DateInput(
                attrs={"type": "date", "class": "form-control"}, format="%Y-%m-%d"
            ),
            "end_date": forms.DateInput(
                attrs={"type": "date", "class": "form-control"}, format="%Y-%m-%d"
            ),
        }

    def __init__(self, *args, organization, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        self.organization = organization
        self.instance.organization_id = organization.pk
        leads = empProfile.objects.filter(organization=organization).filter(
            Q(is_active=True) | Q(pk=self.instance.lead_id)
        )
        self.fields["lead"].queryset = leads.select_related("user").order_by(
            "user__first_name", "user__last_name"
        )
        self.fields["lead"].widget.attrs["class"] = "form-select"
        self.fields["status"].choices = [
            c for c in Project.STATUS_CHOICES if c[0] != Project.STATUS_ARCHIVED
        ]

    def clean_name(self):
        name = (self.cleaned_data.get("name") or "").strip()
        clash = Project.objects.filter(organization=self.organization, name__iexact=name)
        if self.instance.pk:
            clash = clash.exclude(pk=self.instance.pk)
        if clash.exists():
            raise forms.ValidationError(
                "A project with this name already exists in your organization."
            )
        return name

    def clean_code(self):
        code = (self.cleaned_data.get("code") or "").strip().upper()
        clash = Project.objects.filter(organization=self.organization, code=code)
        if self.instance.pk:
            clash = clash.exclude(pk=self.instance.pk)
        if clash.exists():
            raise forms.ValidationError(
                "A project with this code already exists in your organization."
            )
        return code
