import io

from django.contrib.messages import get_messages
from django.core.files.uploadedfile import SimpleUploadedFile
from django.urls import reverse
from openpyxl import Workbook

from app_projects.models import Project
from app_projects.test_views import ViewBase
from appEmp.models import EmployeeImportFieldConfig, empProfile as P

XLSX = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet"
HEADER = ("Full Name", "Email", "Project Code")


class ImportBase(ViewBase):
    def setUp(self):
        EmployeeImportFieldConfig.objects.filter(organization=self.org1).delete()
        EmployeeImportFieldConfig.objects.create(
            organization=self.org1, field_key="full_name", column_label="Full Name",
            display_name="Full Name", target_model="USER", data_type="FULL_NAME",
            is_required=True, order=1,
        )
        EmployeeImportFieldConfig.objects.create(
            organization=self.org1, field_key="email", column_label="Email",
            display_name="Email", target_model="USER", data_type="EMAIL",
            is_required=True, order=2,
        )
        self.client.force_login(self.su)
        session = self.client.session
        session["switched_org_id"] = self.org1.id
        session.save()

    @property
    def url(self):
        return reverse("employeeBulkImport")

    def sheet(self, rows, header=HEADER):
        workbook = Workbook()
        worksheet = workbook.active
        worksheet.append(list(header))
        for row in rows:
            worksheet.append(list(row))
        buffer = io.BytesIO()
        workbook.save(buffer)
        return SimpleUploadedFile("people.xlsx", buffer.getvalue(), content_type=XLSX)

    def preview(self, rows, header=HEADER, **extra):
        data = {"file": self.sheet(rows, header)}
        data.update(extra)
        return self.client.post(self.url, data)

    def confirm(self):
        return self.client.post(self.url, {"action": "confirm_import"})

    def notes(self, response):
        return [message.message for message in get_messages(response.wsgi_request)]

    def imported(self, email):
        return P.objects.filter(user__email=email).first()


class ImportCodeTests(ImportBase):
    def test_code_is_applied(self):
        self.preview([("Ann One", "zz_i1@example.com", "AL")])
        self.confirm()
        self.assertEqual(self.imported("zz_i1@example.com").project_id, self.pa.pk)

    def test_code_is_case_and_space_insensitive(self):
        self.preview([
            ("Ann One", "zz_i2@example.com", "al"),
            ("Bob Two", "zz_i3@example.com", "  Be "),
        ])
        self.confirm()
        self.assertEqual(self.imported("zz_i2@example.com").project_id, self.pa.pk)
        self.assertEqual(self.imported("zz_i3@example.com").project_id, self.pb.pk)

    def test_numeric_code_cell(self):
        numeric = Project.objects.create(organization=self.org1, name="Site 101", code="101")
        self.preview([("Ann One", "zz_i4@example.com", 101)])
        self.confirm()
        self.assertEqual(self.imported("zz_i4@example.com").project_id, numeric.pk)

    def test_unknown_code_blocks_only_its_row(self):
        response = self.preview([
            ("Ann One", "zz_i5@example.com", "ZZZ"),
            ("Bob Two", "zz_i6@example.com", "AL"),
        ])
        self.assertContains(response, "Unknown project code")
        self.confirm()
        self.assertIsNone(self.imported("zz_i5@example.com"))
        self.assertEqual(self.imported("zz_i6@example.com").project_id, self.pa.pk)

    def test_archived_code_blocks_only_its_row(self):
        Project.objects.filter(pk=self.pb.pk).update(status=Project.STATUS_ARCHIVED)
        response = self.preview([
            ("Ann One", "zz_i7@example.com", "BE"),
            ("Bob Two", "zz_i8@example.com", "AL"),
        ])
        self.assertContains(response, "is archived")
        self.confirm()
        self.assertIsNone(self.imported("zz_i7@example.com"))
        self.assertIsNotNone(self.imported("zz_i8@example.com"))

    def test_code_of_another_organization_is_unknown(self):
        response = self.preview([("Ann One", "zz_i9@example.com", "GA")])
        self.assertContains(response, "Unknown project code")
        self.confirm()
        self.assertIsNone(self.imported("zz_i9@example.com"))

    def test_on_hold_code_is_allowed(self):
        Project.objects.filter(pk=self.pb.pk).update(status=Project.STATUS_ON_HOLD)
        self.preview([("Ann One", "zz_j1@example.com", "BE")])
        self.confirm()
        self.assertEqual(self.imported("zz_j1@example.com").project_id, self.pb.pk)

==> ./app_projects/context_processors.py <==
from appEmp.models import empProfile

from .access import can_manage_projects, can_view_all_projects


def project_nav(request):
    """Sidebar flags for the Projects entry."""
    none = {"projects_nav_show": False, "projects_nav_all": False, "projects_nav_manage": False}
    user = getattr(request, "user", None)
    org = getattr(request, "current_org", None)
    if user is None or not user.is_authenticated or org is None:
        return none

    if can_view_all_projects(user, org):
        return {
            "projects_nav_show": True,
            "projects_nav_all": True,
            "projects_nav_manage": can_manage_projects(user, org),
        }

    has_project = empProfile.objects.filter(
        user=user, organization=org, is_active=True, project__isnull=False
    ).exists()
    return {
        "projects_nav_show": has_project,
        "projects_nav_all": False,
        "projects_nav_manage": can_manage_projects(user, org),
    }

import io
import os
import shutil
import tempfile
import zipfile

from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError
from django.core.files.uploadedfile import SimpleUploadedFile
from django.db import connection
from django.test import override_settings
from django.urls import reverse

from app_projects import services
from app_projects.models import Action, ActionAttachment, ActionComment
from app_projects.test_action_views import ActionViewBase


def pdf_file(name="a.pdf"):
    return SimpleUploadedFile(name, b"%PDF-1.4\nhello\n%%EOF", content_type="application/pdf")


def png_file(name="a.png"):
    return SimpleUploadedFile(name, b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n" + b"0" * 20, content_type="image/png")


def jpg_file(name="a.jpg"):
    return SimpleUploadedFile(name, b"\xff\xd8\xff\xe0" + b"0" * 20, content_type="image/jpeg")


def docx_file(name="a.docx", with_word=True):
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(buf, "w") as z:
        z.writestr("[Content_Types].xml", "<Types/>")
        z.writestr("word/document.xml" if with_word else "other.txt", "<w/>")
    return SimpleUploadedFile(name, buf.getvalue())


class ExtrasBase(ActionViewBase):
    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        self.tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp()
        self.addCleanup(shutil.rmtree, self.tmp, True)
        ctx = override_settings(PRIVATE_MEDIA_ROOT=self.tmp)
        ctx.enable()
        self.addCleanup(ctx.disable)

    def u(self, name, action, *extra, project=None):
        return reverse(name, args=[(project or self.pa).uuid, action.uuid, *extra])

    def stored(self, att):
        return os.path.join(self.tmp, att.file.name)


class SubtaskTests(ExtrasBase):

        self.assertEqual(self.client.post(url, self.sub_data()).status_code, 403)
        self.assertEqual(Action.objects.count(), before)

        before = Action.objects.count()
        r = self.client.post(self.u("projectActionSubtaskCreate", self.sub), self.sub_data())

        self.assertEqual(Action.objects.count(), before)

    def test_assignee_from_other_project_is_rejected(self):

        before = Action.objects.count()
        r = self.client.post(
            self.u("projectActionSubtaskCreate", self.a2), self.sub_data(assignee=self.beta_p.pk)
        )
        self.assertEqual(r.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(Action.objects.count(), before)

        url = self.u("projectActionSubtaskCreate", self.a2)

        self.assertEqual(r.status_code, 302)
        self.assertIn("next=", r["Location"])
        self.login(self.beta_user)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.post(url, self.sub_data()).status_code, 404)
        self.login(self.outsider)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.post(url, self.sub_data()).status_code, 404)
        self.login(self.admin)
        wrong = self.u("projectActionSubtaskCreate", self.a2, project=self.pb)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.post(wrong, self.sub_data()).status_code, 404)

    def test_archived_project_blocks_subtask(self):
        self.pa.archive()
        self.login(self.admin)
        before = Action.objects.count()
        self.client.post(self.u("projectActionSubtaskCreate", self.a2), self.sub_data())
        self.assertEqual(Action.objects.count(), before)

        self.assertNotContains(self.client.get(self.detail_url(self.sub)), "Add subtask")

class CommentTests(ExtrasBase):

        c = ActionComment.objects.get()
        self.assertEqual((c.author_id, c.action_id, c.body), (self.mate.pk, self.a1.pk, "Looks good"))
        self.assertContains(self.client.get(self.detail_url(self.a1)), "Looks good")

    def test_body_is_encrypted_at_rest(self):
        self.login(self.mate)
        self.client.post(self.u("projectActionCommentAdd", self.a1), {"body": "Very private note"})
        with connection.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute("select body from %s" % ActionComment._meta.db_table)
            raw = " ".join(str(row[0]) for row in cur.fetchall())
        self.assertTrue(raw)
        self.assertNotIn("Very private note", raw)

    def test_empty_whitespace_and_overlong_are_rejected(self):
        self.login(self.mate)
        url = self.u("projectActionCommentAdd", self.a1)
        for body in ("", "   ", "x" * 5001):
            self.client.post(url, {"body": body})
        self.assertEqual(ActionComment.objects.count(), 0)

    def test_add_get_is_405_and_access_rules(self):
        url = self.u("projectActionCommentAdd", self.a1)
        r = self.client.post(url, {"body": "hi"})
        self.assertEqual(r.status_code, 302)
        self.assertIn("next=", r["Location"])
        self.login(self.mate)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get(url).status_code, 405)
        self.login(self.beta_user)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.post(url, {"body": "hi"}).status_code, 404)
        self.login(self.outsider)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.post(url, {"body": "hi"}).status_code, 404)
        own = self.u("projectActionCommentAdd", self.a1, project=self.pc)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.post(own, {"body": "hi"}).status_code, 404)
        self.assertEqual(ActionComment.objects.count(), 0)

    def test_author_edits_own_comment(self):
        c = self.new_comment(self.worker)
        self.login(self.worker)
        url = self.u("projectActionCommentEdit", self.a1, c.uuid)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get(url).status_code, 200)
        r = self.client.post(url, {"body": "Changed"})
        self.assertRedirects(r, self.detail_url(self.a1), fetch_redirect_response=False)
        c.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(c.body, "Changed")
        self.assertIsNotNone(c.edited_at)

    def test_other_member_cannot_edit_or_delete(self):
        c = self.new_comment(self.worker)
        self.login(self.mate)
        edit = self.u("projectActionCommentEdit", self.a1, c.uuid)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get(edit).status_code, 403)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.post(edit, {"body": "Hacked"}).status_code, 403)
        r = self.client.post(self.u("projectActionCommentDelete", self.a1, c.uuid))
        self.assertEqual(r.status_code, 403)
        c.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(c.body, "First note")

    def test_manager_can_edit_and_delete_any_comment(self):
        c = self.new_comment(self.worker)
        self.login(self.admin)
        self.client.post(self.u("projectActionCommentEdit", self.a1, c.uuid), {"body": "Moderated"})
        c.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(c.body, "Moderated")
        self.client.post(self.u("projectActionCommentDelete", self.a1, c.uuid))
        self.assertFalse(ActionComment.objects.filter(pk=c.pk).exists())

    def test_author_deletes_own_comment(self):
        c = self.new_comment(self.worker)
        self.login(self.worker)
        r = self.client.post(self.u("projectActionCommentDelete", self.a1, c.uuid))
        self.assertRedirects(r, self.detail_url(self.a1), fetch_redirect_response=False)
        self.assertFalse(ActionComment.objects.filter(pk=c.pk).exists())

    def test_delete_get_is_405(self):

        self.login(self.worker)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get(self.u("projectActionCommentDelete", self.a1, c.uuid)).status_code, 405)

    def test_comment_under_wrong_action_gets_404(self):

        self.assertEqual(self.client.get(self.u("projectActionCommentEdit", self.a1, c.uuid)).status_code, 404)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.post(self.u("projectActionCommentDelete", self.a1, c.uuid)).status_code, 404)
        self.assertTrue(ActionComment.objects.filter(pk=c.pk).exists())

    def test_archived_project_blocks_add_edit_delete(self):
        c = self.new_comment(self.worker)
        self.pa.archive()
        self.login(self.worker)
        self.client.post(self.u("projectActionCommentAdd", self.a1), {"body": "Late"})
        self.client.post(self.u("projectActionCommentEdit", self.a1, c.uuid), {"body": "Late edit"})
        self.client.post(self.u("projectActionCommentDelete", self.a1, c.uuid))
        self.assertEqual(ActionComment.objects.count(), 1)
        c.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(c.body, "First note")
        r = self.client.get(self.detail_url(self.a1))
        self.assertContains(r, "First note")
        self.assertNotContains(r, "Add comment")
        self.assertNotContains(r, "Edit comment")

    def test_form_and_links_shown_to_the_right_people(self):
        self.new_comment(self.worker)

        r = self.client.get(self.detail_url(self.a1))

        self.assertContains(r, "Edit comment")
        self.login(self.mate)
        r = self.client.get(self.detail_url(self.a1))
        self.assertContains(r, "Add comment")
        self.assertNotContains(r, "Edit comment")
        self.assertNotContains(r, "Delete comment")


class AttachmentTests(ExtrasBase):
    def add(self, user=None, upload=None, action=None):
        return services.add_attachment(action or self.a1, user or self.admin, upload or pdf_file())

    def post_file(self, upload, action=None):
        return self.client.post(self.u("projectActionAttachmentAdd", action or self.a1), {"file": upload})

    def test_member_uploads_each_allowed_type(self):
        self.login(self.mate)
        for upload in (pdf_file(), png_file(), jpg_file(), docx_file()):
            r = self.post_file(upload)
            self.assertRedirects(r, self.detail_url(self.a1), fetch_redirect_response=False)
        self.assertEqual(ActionAttachment.objects.count(), 4)

    def test_stored_under_org_path_with_random_name_and_safe_metadata(self):
        att = self.add(upload=pdf_file("../../evil.pdf"))
        prefix = "org_%s/actions/%s/" % (self.pa.organization_id, self.a1.uuid)
        self.assertTrue(att.file.name.startswith(prefix))
        self.assertNotIn("..", att.file.name)
        self.assertNotIn("evil", att.file.name)
        self.assertEqual(att.original_name, "evil.pdf")
        self.assertEqual(att.content_type, "application/pdf")
        self.assertEqual(att.uploaded_by_id, self.admin.pk)
        self.assertTrue(os.path.exists(self.stored(att)))

    def test_bad_files_are_rejected(self):
        self.login(self.admin)
        bad = [
            SimpleUploadedFile("big.pdf", b"%PDF-" + b"0" * (200 * 1024)),
            SimpleUploadedFile("fake.pdf", b"just some text"),
            SimpleUploadedFile("mismatch.jpg", b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n" + b"0" * 10),
            SimpleUploadedFile("run.exe", b"MZ" + b"0" * 10),
            SimpleUploadedFile("page.html", b"<html></html>"),
            SimpleUploadedFile("empty.pdf", b""),
            SimpleUploadedFile("notzip.docx", b"PK not really a zip"),
            docx_file("noword.docx", with_word=False),
        ]
        for upload in bad:
            self.post_file(upload)
        self.assertEqual(ActionAttachment.objects.count(), 0)
        self.assertEqual(os.listdir(self.tmp), [])

    def test_limit_of_20_files_per_action(self):
        for i in range(20):
            self.add(upload=pdf_file("f%d.pdf" % i))
        with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
            self.add(upload=pdf_file("one_too_many.pdf"))
        self.assertEqual(ActionAttachment.objects.count(), 20)

    def test_download_sends_attachment_with_safe_headers(self):
        att = self.add(upload=pdf_file("report.pdf"))
        self.login(self.mate)
        r = self.client.get(self.u("projectActionAttachmentDownload", self.a1, att.uuid))
        self.assertEqual(r.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(b"".join(r.streaming_content), b"%PDF-1.4\nhello\n%%EOF")
        self.assertIn("attachment", r["Content-Disposition"])
        self.assertIn("report.pdf", r["Content-Disposition"])
        self.assertEqual(r["X-Content-Type-Options"], "nosniff")
        self.assertIn("no-store", r["Cache-Control"])

    def test_detail_page_links_only_to_the_download_view(self):
        att = self.add()
        self.login(self.mate)
        r = self.client.get(self.detail_url(self.a1))
        self.assertContains(r, self.u("projectActionAttachmentDownload", self.a1, att.uuid))
        self.assertNotContains(r, att.file.name)

    def test_download_access_rules(self):
        att = self.add()
        url = self.u("projectActionAttachmentDownload", self.a1, att.uuid)
        r = self.client.get(url)
        self.assertEqual(r.status_code, 302)
        self.assertIn("next=", r["Location"])
        self.login(self.beta_user)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get(url).status_code, 404)
        self.login(self.outsider)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get(url).status_code, 404)
        own = self.u("projectActionAttachmentDownload", self.a1, att.uuid, project=self.pc)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get(own).status_code, 404)
        self.login(self.admin)
        wrong_action = self.u("projectActionAttachmentDownload", self.a2, att.uuid)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get(wrong_action).status_code, 404)

    def test_download_of_missing_file_gets_404(self):
        att = self.add()
        os.remove(self.stored(att))
        self.login(self.admin)
        r = self.client.get(self.u("projectActionAttachmentDownload", self.a1, att.uuid))
        self.assertEqual(r.status_code, 404)

    def test_upload_access_rules(self):
        url = self.u("projectActionAttachmentAdd", self.a1)
        r = self.client.post(url, {"file": pdf_file()})
        self.assertEqual(r.status_code, 302)
        self.assertIn("next=", r["Location"])
        self.login(self.mate)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get(url).status_code, 405)
        self.login(self.beta_user)
        self.assertEqual(self.post_file(pdf_file()).status_code, 404)
        self.login(self.outsider)
        self.assertEqual(self.post_file(pdf_file()).status_code, 404)
        self.assertEqual(ActionAttachment.objects.count(), 0)

    def test_uploader_deletes_own_and_file_is_removed(self):
        att = self.add(self.worker)
        path = self.stored(att)
        self.login(self.worker)
        with self.captureOnCommitCallbacks(execute=True):
            r = self.client.post(self.u("projectActionAttachmentDelete", self.a1, att.uuid))
        self.assertRedirects(r, self.detail_url(self.a1), fetch_redirect_response=False)
        self.assertFalse(ActionAttachment.objects.filter(pk=att.pk).exists())
        self.assertFalse(os.path.exists(path))

    def test_other_member_cannot_delete_but_manager_can(self):
        att = self.add(self.worker)
        url = self.u("projectActionAttachmentDelete", self.a1, att.uuid)
        self.login(self.mate)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.post(url).status_code, 403)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get(url).status_code, 405)
        self.assertTrue(ActionAttachment.objects.filter(pk=att.pk).exists())
        self.login(self.admin)
        self.client.post(url)
        self.assertFalse(ActionAttachment.objects.filter(pk=att.pk).exists())

    def test_archived_project_blocks_upload_and_delete_but_not_download(self):
        att = self.add()
        self.pa.archive()
        self.login(self.admin)
        self.post_file(pdf_file("late.pdf"))
        self.client.post(self.u("projectActionAttachmentDelete", self.a1, att.uuid))
        self.assertEqual(ActionAttachment.objects.count(), 1)
        r = self.client.get(self.u("projectActionAttachmentDownload", self.a1, att.uuid))
        self.assertEqual(r.status_code, 200)
        page = self.client.get(self.detail_url(self.a1))
        self.assertNotContains(page, "Upload")
        self.assertNotContains(page, "Delete attachment")

    def test_deleting_an_action_removes_its_files_after_commit(self):
        att = self.add(action=self.a2)
        path = self.stored(att)
        with self.captureOnCommitCallbacks(execute=True):
            services.delete_action(self.a2, self.admin)
        self.assertFalse(os.path.exists(path))

    def test_upload_form_visible_to_members(self):
        self.login(self.mate)
        self.assertContains(self.client.get(self.detail_url(self.a1)), "Upload")

from django import forms
from django.db.models import Q

from appEmp.models import empProfile

from .forms import LeadChoiceField


class ActionForm(forms.Form):
    title = forms.CharField(
        max_length=200, widget=forms.TextInput(attrs={"class": "form-control"})
    )
    description = forms.CharField(
        required=False,
        max_length=5000,
        widget=forms.Textarea(attrs={"class": "form-control", "rows": 5}),
    )
    assignee = LeadChoiceField(
        queryset=empProfile.objects.none(), required=False, empty_label="Unassigned"
    )
    due_date = forms.DateField(
        required=False,
        widget=forms.DateInput(
            attrs={"type": "date", "class": "form-control"}, format="%Y-%m-%d"
        ),
    )

    def __init__(self, *args, project, current_assignee_id=None, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        allowed = Q(project=project, is_active=True)
        if current_assignee_id:
            allowed |= Q(pk=current_assignee_id)
        self.fields["assignee"].queryset = (
            empProfile.objects.filter(organization=project.organization)
            .filter(allowed)
            .select_related("user")
            .order_by("user__first_name", "user__last_name")
        )
        self.fields["assignee"].widget.attrs["class"] = "form-select"


class ReassignForm(forms.Form):
    assignee = LeadChoiceField(
        queryset=empProfile.objects.none(), required=False, empty_label="Unassigned"
    )

    def __init__(self, *args, project, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        self.fields["assignee"].queryset = (
            empProfile.objects.filter(
                organization=project.organization, project=project, is_active=True
            )
            .select_related("user")
            .order_by("user__first_name", "user__last_name")
        )
        self.fields["assignee"].widget.attrs["class"] = "form-select"


class CommentForm(forms.Form):
    body = forms.CharField(
        max_length=5000,
        widget=forms.Textarea(attrs={"class": "form-control", "rows": 4}),
    )


class AttachmentForm(forms.Form):
    file = forms.FileField()

from django.urls import reverse

from app_projects.models import Action, ActionEvent
from app_projects.test_action_views import ActionViewBase


class StatusRouteBase(ActionViewBase):
    def status_url(self, action, project=None):
        return reverse("projectActionStatus", args=[(project or self.pa).uuid, action.uuid])

    def reassign_url(self, action, project=None):
        return reverse("projectActionReassign", args=[(project or self.pa).uuid, action.uuid])

    def delete_url(self, action, project=None):
        return reverse("projectActionDelete", args=[(project or self.pa).uuid, action.uuid])


class StatusViewTests(StatusRouteBase):
    def test_assignee_changes_status_and_event_is_written(self):
        self.login(self.worker)
        r = self.client.post(self.status_url(self.a1), {"status": "in_progress"})
        self.assertRedirects(r, self.detail_url(self.a1), fetch_redirect_response=False)
        self.a1.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(self.a1.status, "in_progress")
        self.assertEqual(self.a1.events.filter(kind=ActionEvent.KIND_STATUS).count(), 1)

    def test_admin_changes_status_of_any_action(self):
        self.login(self.admin)
        self.client.post(self.status_url(self.a2), {"status": "review"})
        self.a2.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(self.a2.status, "review")

    def test_done_sets_completed_at(self):
        self.login(self.worker)
        self.client.post(self.status_url(self.a1), {"status": "done"})
        self.a1.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertIsNotNone(self.a1.completed_at)

    def test_non_assignee_member_gets_403(self):
        self.login(self.mate)
        r = self.client.post(self.status_url(self.a1), {"status": "done"})
        self.assertEqual(r.status_code, 403)
        self.a1.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(self.a1.status, "todo")

    def test_invalid_status_is_rejected(self):
        self.login(self.admin)
        r = self.client.post(self.status_url(self.a1), {"status": "bogus"})
        self.assertEqual(r.status_code, 302)
        self.a1.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(self.a1.status, "todo")
        self.assertEqual(self.a1.events.filter(kind=ActionEvent.KIND_STATUS).count(), 0)

    def test_missing_status_is_rejected(self):
        self.login(self.admin)
        self.client.post(self.status_url(self.a1), {})
        self.a1.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(self.a1.status, "todo")

    def test_get_is_405(self):
        self.login(self.admin)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get(self.status_url(self.a1)).status_code, 405)

    def test_anonymous_is_sent_to_login(self):
        r = self.client.post(self.status_url(self.a1), {"status": "done"})
        self.assertEqual(r.status_code, 302)
        self.assertIn("next=", r["Location"])

    def test_other_project_member_gets_404(self):
        self.login(self.beta_user)
        r = self.client.post(self.status_url(self.a1), {"status": "done"})
        self.assertEqual(r.status_code, 404)

    def test_other_org_gets_404(self):
        self.login(self.outsider)
        r = self.client.post(self.status_url(self.a1), {"status": "done"})
        self.assertEqual(r.status_code, 404)

    def test_wrong_project_in_url_gets_404(self):
        self.login(self.admin)
        r = self.client.post(self.status_url(self.a1, project=self.pb), {"status": "done"})
        self.assertEqual(r.status_code, 404)

    def test_archived_project_blocks_change(self):
        self.pa.archive()
        self.login(self.admin)
        self.client.post(self.status_url(self.a1), {"status": "done"})
        self.a1.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(self.a1.status, "todo")

from datetime import date

from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError
from django.db import IntegrityError, transaction
from django.db.models import ProtectedError
from django.test import TestCase

from app_organizations.models import Organization
from app_projects.models import Project
from appEmp.models import empProfile as P


class Base(TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpTestData(cls):
        User.objects.bulk_create([
            User(username="zz_su", email="zz_su@example.com", is_staff=True, is_superuser=True, password="!")
        ])
        cls.su = User.objects.get(username="zz_su")
        cls.org1 = Organization.objects.create(name="ZZ Org One", created_by=cls.su)
        cls.org2 = Organization.objects.create(name="ZZ Org Two", created_by=cls.su)

    def make(self, org, email, **fields):
        user = User(username=email, email=email, first_name="Zz", last_name="Test")
        user.set_unusable_password()
        user._organization = org
        user.save()
        profile = P.objects.get(user=user)
        if fields:
            for key, value in fields.items():
                setattr(profile, key, value)
            profile.save()
        return profile

    def project(self, org, name="Prayagraj", code="PRY", **fields):
        return Project.objects.create(organization=org, name=name, code=code, **fields)


class ProjectModelTests(Base):
    def test_uuid_is_generated_and_unique(self):
        a = self.project(self.org1, "A", "AAA")
        b = self.project(self.org1, "B", "BBB")
        self.assertIsNotNone(a.uuid)
        self.assertNotEqual(a.uuid, b.uuid)

    def test_name_unique_per_org_case_insensitive(self):
        self.project(self.org1, "Prayagraj", "PRY")
        with self.assertRaises(IntegrityError), transaction.atomic():
            self.project(self.org1, "prayagraj", "PRY2")
        with self.assertRaises(IntegrityError), transaction.atomic():
            self.project(self.org1, "  PRAYAGRAJ  ", "PRY3")

    def test_same_name_and_code_allowed_in_another_org(self):
        self.project(self.org1, "Prayagraj", "PRY")
        other = self.project(self.org2, "Prayagraj", "PRY")
        self.assertEqual(other.organization_id, self.org2.id)

    def test_code_is_upper_cased_and_unique_per_org(self):
        p = self.project(self.org1, "Prayagraj", "pry")
        p.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(p.code, "PRY")
        with self.assertRaises(IntegrityError), transaction.atomic():
            self.project(self.org1, "Other Name", "PRY")

    def test_end_date_before_start_is_rejected(self):
        p = Project(
            organization=self.org1, name="Dates", code="DT",
            start_date=date(2026, 5, 1), end_date=date(2026, 4, 1),
        )
        with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
            p.clean()
        with self.assertRaises(IntegrityError), transaction.atomic():
            p.save()

    def test_equal_or_missing_dates_are_allowed(self):
        self.project(self.org1, "Same Day", "SD", start_date=date(2026, 5, 1), end_date=date(2026, 5, 1))
        self.project(self.org1, "Open Ended", "OE", start_date=date(2026, 5, 1))
        self.project(self.org1, "No Dates", "ND")

    def test_lead_from_another_org_is_rejected(self):
        outsider = self.make(self.org2, "zz_lead_other@example.com")
        p = Project(organization=self.org1, name="Lead Test", code="LT", lead=outsider)
        with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
            p.save()
        with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
            p.clean()

    def test_lead_from_same_org_is_allowed(self):
        lead = self.make(self.org1, "zz_lead_same@example.com")
        p = self.project(self.org1, "Lead OK", "LK", lead=lead)
        self.assertEqual(p.lead_id, lead.id)
        self.assertIn(p, lead.led_projects.all())


class EmployeeProjectTests(Base):
    def test_new_employee_has_no_project(self):
        p = self.make(self.org1, "zz_none@example.com")
        self.assertIsNone(p.project_id)

    def test_employee_can_join_project_of_own_org(self):
        proj = self.project(self.org1)
        emp = self.make(self.org1, "zz_same@example.com", project=proj)
        emp.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(emp.project_id, proj.id)
        self.assertEqual(list(proj.employees.all()), [emp])

    def test_project_of_another_org_is_rejected_on_full_save(self):
        foreign = self.project(self.org2, "Foreign", "FR")
        emp = self.make(self.org1, "zz_cross1@example.com")
        emp.project = foreign
        with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
            emp.save()
        emp.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertIsNone(emp.project_id)

    def test_project_of_another_org_is_rejected_with_update_fields(self):
        foreign = self.project(self.org2, "Foreign", "FR")
        emp = self.make(self.org1, "zz_cross2@example.com")
        emp.project = foreign
        with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
            emp.save(update_fields=["project"])
        emp.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertIsNone(emp.project_id)

    def test_clearing_the_project_is_allowed(self):
        proj = self.project(self.org1)
        emp = self.make(self.org1, "zz_clear@example.com", project=proj)
        emp.project = None
        emp.save(update_fields=["project"])
        emp.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertIsNone(emp.project_id)


class DeleteAndArchiveTests(Base):
    def test_project_with_employees_cannot_be_deleted(self):
        proj = self.project(self.org1)
        self.make(self.org1, "zz_del@example.com", project=proj)
        with self.assertRaises(ProtectedError):
            proj.delete()
        self.assertTrue(Project.objects.filter(pk=proj.pk).exists())

    def test_empty_project_can_be_deleted(self):
        proj = self.project(self.org1)
        proj.delete()
        self.assertFalse(Project.objects.filter(pk=proj.pk).exists())

    def test_archive_keeps_employees_attached(self):
        proj = self.project(self.org1)
        emp = self.make(self.org1, "zz_arch@example.com", project=proj)
        proj.archive()
        proj.refresh_from_db()
        emp.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(proj.status, Project.STATUS_ARCHIVED)
        self.assertTrue(proj.is_archived)
        self.assertEqual(emp.project_id, proj.id)

    def test_deleting_a_lead_clears_the_lead_not_the_project(self):
        lead = self.make(self.org1, "zz_lead_del@example.com")
        proj = self.project(self.org1, "Lead Del", "LD", lead=lead)
        Project.objects.filter(pk=proj.pk).update(lead=None)
        proj.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertIsNone(proj.lead_id)


class FlashMessageTests(Base):
    def setUp(self):
        self.client.force_login(self.su)
        session = self.client.session
        session["switched_org_id"] = self.org1.id
        session.save()

    def _alert_count_after(self, url_name, project):
        from django.urls import reverse
        response = self.client.post(reverse(url_name, args=[project.uuid]), follow=True)
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        self.assertNotContains(response, '<div class="sky-calendar-message">')
        return response

    def test_flash_shows_once_after_archive(self):
        project = self.project(self.org1, "Flash One", "FL1")
        response = self._alert_count_after("projectArchive", project)
        self.assertContains(response, 'class="alert alert-', count=1)

    def test_flash_shows_once_after_unarchive(self):
        project = self.project(self.org1, "Flash Two", "FL2")
        project.archive()
        response = self._alert_count_after("projectUnarchive", project)
        self.assertContains(response, 'class="alert alert-', count=1)

    def test_project_pages_do_not_print_messages_themselves(self):
        from django.template.loader import get_template
        for name in ("app_projects/list.html", "app_projects/detail.html"):
            with open(get_template(name).origin.name, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
                self.assertNotIn("{% if messages %}", handle.read(), name)

from django.test import RequestFactory
from django.urls import reverse

from app_projects.filters import (
    clean_project_filter,
    project_filter_context,
)
from app_projects.models import Project
from app_projects.test_views import ViewBase
from appEmp.views import _filtered_emp_queryset


class FilterBase(ViewBase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.client.force_login(self.su)
        session = self.client.session
        session["switched_org_id"] = self.org1.id
        session.save()
        self.in_a = self.make(self.org1, "zz_f1@example.com", project=self.pa)
        self.in_b = self.make(self.org1, "zz_f2@example.com", project=self.pb)
        self.loose = self.make(self.org1, "zz_f3@example.com")

    def listed(self, **params):
        response = self.client.get(reverse("employeeList"), params)
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        return response, {row["uuid"] for row in response.context["objects"]}


class EmployeeListFilterTests(FilterBase):
    def test_filter_by_project(self):
        _, found = self.listed(project=str(self.pa.uuid))
        self.assertIn(self.in_a.uuid, found)
        self.assertNotIn(self.in_b.uuid, found)
        self.assertNotIn(self.loose.uuid, found)

    def test_filter_unassigned(self):
        _, found = self.listed(project="unassigned")
        self.assertIn(self.loose.uuid, found)
        self.assertNotIn(self.in_a.uuid, found)
        self.assertNotIn(self.in_b.uuid, found)

    def test_archived_project_can_be_filtered_and_is_labelled(self):
        Project.objects.filter(pk=self.pb.pk).update(status=Project.STATUS_ARCHIVED)
        response, found = self.listed(project=str(self.pb.uuid))
        self.assertIn(self.in_b.uuid, found)
        self.assertNotIn(self.in_a.uuid, found)
        labels = {
            o["uuid"]: o["label"] for o in response.context["project_filter_options"]
        }
        self.assertTrue(labels[str(self.pb.uuid)].endswith(" (archived)"))

    def test_other_org_project_uuid_is_ignored(self):
        response, found = self.listed(project=str(self.pc.uuid))
        self.assertEqual(response.context["project_filter_selected"], "")
        self.assertIn(self.in_a.uuid, found)
        self.assertIn(self.in_b.uuid, found)
        self.assertIn(self.loose.uuid, found)

    def test_garbage_value_is_ignored(self):
        response, found = self.listed(project="not-a-uuid")
        self.assertEqual(response.context["project_filter_selected"], "")
        self.assertIn(self.in_a.uuid, found)
        self.assertIn(self.loose.uuid, found)

    def test_pdf_accepts_the_same_filter(self):
        response = self.client.get(
            reverse("employeeListPdf"), {"project": str(self.pa.uuid)}
        )
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(response["Content-Type"], "application/pdf")


class FilterVisibilityTests(FilterBase):
    def request_for(self, user, **params):
        request = RequestFactory().get("/", params)
        request.user = user
        request.current_org = self.org1
        return request

    def test_dropdown_shown_to_superuser(self):
        context = project_filter_context(self.request_for(self.su))

        member = self.person(self.org1, "zz_fmem@example.com", role="member")
        self.assertTrue(project_filter_context(self.request_for(manager))["project_filter_show"])
        self.assertFalse(project_filter_context(self.request_for(member))["project_filter_show"])

    def test_member_cannot_filter_by_url(self):

        queryset, _ = _filtered_emp_queryset(request)
        found = set(queryset.values_list("uuid", flat=True))
        self.assertIn(self.in_a.uuid, found)
        self.assertIn(self.in_b.uuid, found)
        self.assertIn(self.loose.uuid, found)

from datetime import date

from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from django.urls import reverse

from app_projects.models import Project
from app_projects.test_leave_filters import LeaveFilterBase
from appEmp.models import Attendance, AttendanceException, empProfile


class ExceptionFilterBase(LeaveFilterBase):
    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        today = date.today()
        self.exc_a, self.exc_b, self.exc_x = [
            AttendanceException.objects.create(
                attendance=Attendance.objects.create(employee=emp, date=today),
                raised_by=User.objects.get(pk=emp.user_id),
                reason="test",
            )
            for emp in (self.in_a, self.in_b, self.loose)
        ]

    def exceptions(self, **params):
        response = self.client.get(reverse("pendingAttendanceExceptions"), params)
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        uuids = {e.uuid for e in response.context["exception_requests"]}
        return response, uuids

    def everyone(self):
        return {self.exc_a.uuid, self.exc_b.uuid, self.exc_x.uuid}


class ReviewerExceptionFilterTests(ExceptionFilterBase):
    def test_dropdown_shown(self):
        response, _ = self.exceptions()
        self.assertTrue(response.context["project_filter_show"])

    def test_no_filter_shows_everyone(self):
        _, uuids = self.exceptions()
        self.assertEqual(uuids, self.everyone())

    def test_filter_by_project(self):
        _, uuids = self.exceptions(project=str(self.pa.uuid))
        self.assertEqual(uuids, {self.exc_a.uuid})

    def test_filter_unassigned(self):
        _, uuids = self.exceptions(project="unassigned")
        self.assertEqual(uuids, {self.exc_x.uuid})

    def test_archived_project_still_filters(self):
        Project.objects.filter(pk=self.pb.pk).update(status=Project.STATUS_ARCHIVED)
        _, uuids = self.exceptions(project=str(self.pb.uuid))
        self.assertEqual(uuids, {self.exc_b.uuid})

    def test_other_org_project_uuid_is_ignored(self):
        response, uuids = self.exceptions(project=str(self.pc.uuid))
        self.assertEqual(response.context["project_filter_selected"], "")
        self.assertEqual(uuids, self.everyone())


class ExceptionManagerScopeTests(ExceptionFilterBase):
    def report_to(self, user):
        manager = empProfile.objects.get(user=user)
        empProfile.objects.filter(pk__in=[self.in_a.pk, self.in_b.pk]).update(
            manager=manager
        )

    def test_manager_role_filters_within_own_reports_only(self):
        user = self.person(self.org1, "zz_amgr@example.com", role="manager")
        self.report_to(user)
        self.client.force_login(user)

        response, uuids = self.exceptions()
        self.assertTrue(response.context["project_filter_show"])
        self.assertEqual(uuids, {self.exc_a.uuid, self.exc_b.uuid})

        _, uuids = self.exceptions(project=str(self.pa.uuid))
        self.assertEqual(uuids, {self.exc_a.uuid})

        _, uuids = self.exceptions(project="unassigned")
        self.assertEqual(uuids, set())

    def test_member_manager_gets_no_dropdown_and_url_is_ignored(self):
        user = self.person(self.org1, "zz_amem@example.com", role="member")
        self.report_to(user)
        self.client.force_login(user)

        response, uuids = self.exceptions(project=str(self.pa.uuid))
        self.assertFalse(response.context["project_filter_show"])
        self.assertEqual(response.context["project_filter_selected"], "")
        self.assertEqual(uuids, {self.exc_a.uuid, self.exc_b.uuid})

from io import StringIO

from django.contrib.auth.models import AnonymousUser, Group, Permission, User
from django.core.management import call_command
from django.http import Http404
from django.test import RequestFactory, TestCase

from app_organizations.models import Organization, OrganizationMember
from app_organizations.seed import (
    ORG_ADMIN_GROUP,
    ORG_ADMIN_PERMISSIONS,
    ensure_org_admin_group,
)
from app_projects import access
from app_projects.models import Project
from appEmp.models import empProfile as P

PROJECT_CODENAMES = {"view_all_projects", "manage_projects"}


class AccessBase(TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpTestData(cls):
        User.objects.bulk_create([
            User(username="zz_su", email="zz_su@example.com", is_staff=True, is_superuser=True, password="!")
        ])
        cls.su = User.objects.get(username="zz_su")
        cls.org1 = Organization.objects.create(name="ZZ Org One", created_by=cls.su)
        cls.org2 = Organization.objects.create(name="ZZ Org Two", created_by=cls.su)
        cls.pa = Project.objects.create(organization=cls.org1, name="Alpha", code="AL")
        cls.pb = Project.objects.create(organization=cls.org1, name="Beta", code="BE")
        cls.pc = Project.objects.create(organization=cls.org2, name="Gamma", code="GA")

    def make(self, org, email, **fields):
        user = User(username=email, email=email, first_name="Zz", last_name="Test")
        user.set_unusable_password()
        user._organization = org
        user.save()
        profile = P.objects.get(user=user)
        if fields:
            for key, value in fields.items():
                setattr(profile, key, value)
            profile.save()
        return profile

    def person(self, org, email, role="member", perms=(), project=None):
        fields = {"project": project} if project is not None else {}
        profile = self.make(org, email, **fields)
        OrganizationMember.objects.filter(user_id=profile.user_id).update(role=role)
        user = User.objects.get(pk=profile.user_id)
        for codename in perms:
            user.user_permissions.add(
                Permission.objects.get(
                    content_type__app_label="app_projects", codename=codename
                )
            )
        return User.objects.get(pk=user.pk)

    def req(self, user, org):
        request = RequestFactory().get("/")
        request.user = user
        request.current_org = org
        return request

    def seen(self, user, org):
        return set(access.visible_projects(self.req(user, org)))


class VisibilityTests(AccessBase):
    def test_superuser_sees_every_project_of_the_current_org_only(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.seen(self.su, self.org1), {self.pa, self.pb})
        self.assertEqual(self.seen(self.su, self.org2), {self.pc})

    def test_owner_admin_manager_see_all_in_own_org_only(self):
        for role in ("owner", "admin", "manager"):
            user = self.person(self.org1, "zz_" + role + "@example.com", role=role)
            self.assertEqual(self.seen(user, self.org1), {self.pa, self.pb}, role)
            self.assertEqual(self.seen(user, self.org2), set(), role)

    def test_permission_holder_sees_all_in_own_org(self):
        user = self.person(self.org1, "zz_perm@example.com", perms=["view_all_projects"])
        self.assertEqual(self.seen(user, self.org1), {self.pa, self.pb})

    def test_permission_does_not_work_in_another_org(self):
        user = self.person(self.org1, "zz_perm2@example.com", perms=["view_all_projects"])
        self.assertEqual(self.seen(user, self.org2), set())

    def test_member_sees_only_own_project(self):
        user = self.person(self.org1, "zz_mem@example.com", project=self.pa)
        self.assertEqual(self.seen(user, self.org1), {self.pa})

    def test_member_without_project_sees_nothing(self):
        user = self.person(self.org1, "zz_none@example.com")
        self.assertEqual(self.seen(user, self.org1), set())

    def test_inactive_member_sees_nothing(self):
        user = self.person(self.org1, "zz_inactive@example.com", project=self.pa)
        P.objects.filter(user=user).update(is_active=False)
        self.assertEqual(self.seen(user, self.org1), set())

    def test_no_current_org_sees_nothing(self):
        user = self.person(self.org1, "zz_noorg@example.com", role="owner")

class GroupSeedTests(AccessBase):
    def test_org_admin_group_keeps_project_permissions(self):
        group = ensure_org_admin_group()
        codenames = set(group.permissions.values_list("codename", flat=True))
        self.assertEqual(codenames, set(ORG_ADMIN_PERMISSIONS) | PROJECT_CODENAMES)

    def test_sync_adds_project_permissions_and_keeps_the_rest(self):
        app_perms = list(
            Permission.objects.filter(
                content_type__app_label="appEmp", codename__in=ORG_ADMIN_PERMISSIONS
            )
        )
        org_admin, _ = Group.objects.get_or_create(name=ORG_ADMIN_GROUP)
        org_admin.permissions.set(app_perms)
        hr, _ = Group.objects.get_or_create(name="HR_ADMIN")
        hr.permissions.set(app_perms[:1])

        for _run in range(2):
            call_command("sync_project_permissions", stdout=StringIO())

        org_codes = set(org_admin.permissions.values_list("codename", flat=True))
        self.assertEqual(org_codes, set(ORG_ADMIN_PERMISSIONS) | PROJECT_CODENAMES)
        hr_codes = set(hr.permissions.values_list("codename", flat=True))
        self.assertEqual(hr_codes, {app_perms[0].codename} | PROJECT_CODENAMES)

    def test_sync_skips_a_missing_group(self):
        Group.objects.filter(name="HR_ADMIN").delete()
        out = StringIO()
        call_command("sync_project_permissions", stdout=out)
        self.assertIn("HR_ADMIN: group not found", out.getvalue())
        self.assertFalse(Group.objects.filter(name="HR_ADMIN").exists())

import uuid as uuid_lib
from urllib.parse import urlencode

from django.contrib import messages
from django.contrib.auth.decorators import login_required

from django.core.paginator import Paginator

from appEmp.models import empProfile

from . import services
from .access import can_manage_projects, get_visible_project_or_404, visible_projects

PAGE_SIZE = 25


def _list_url(project, **params):
    url = reverse("projectActionList", args=[project.uuid])
    query = urlencode({k: v for k, v in params.items() if v})
    return url + ("?" + query if query else "")


def _detail_url(project, action):
    return reverse("projectActionDetail", args=[project.uuid, action.uuid])


def _can_edit(request, org, project):
    return can_manage_projects(request.user, org) and not project.is_archived


def _get_action(project, action_uuid):
    return get_object_or_404(
        Action.objects.select_related(
            "assignee__user", "parent", "project", "organization", "created_by"
        ),
        project=project,
        organization=project.organization,
        uuid=action_uuid,
    )


def _form_errors(form, exc):
    if hasattr(exc, "error_dict"):
        for field, errors in exc.message_dict.items():
            form.add_error(field if field in form.fields else None, errors)
    else:
        form.add_error(None, exc.messages)


def _person_name(profile):
    return profile.user.get_full_name() or profile.user.username


def _history(events, org):
    status_labels = dict(Action.STATUS_CHOICES)
    ids = set()
    for e in events:
        if e.kind == "assignee":
            for value in (e.from_value, e.to_value):
                if value.isdigit():
                    ids.add(int(value))
    names = {
        p.pk: _person_name(p)
        for p in empProfile.objects.filter(organization=org, pk__in=ids).select_related("user")
    }

    def who(value):
        return names.get(int(value), "Unknown") if value.isdigit() else "Unassigned"

    lines = []
    for e in events:
        if e.kind == "created":
            text = "Created as %s" % status_labels.get(e.to_value, e.to_value)
        elif e.kind == "status":
            text = "Status: %s to %s" % (
                status_labels.get(e.from_value, e.from_value),
                status_labels.get(e.to_value, e.to_value),
            )
        elif e.kind == "assignee":
            text = "Assignee: %s to %s" % (who(e.from_value), who(e.to_value))
        else:
            text = "Edited: %s" % e.to_value.replace(",", ", ")
        lines.append({
            "when": e.created_at,
            "who": (e.actor.get_full_name() or e.actor.username) if e.actor else "System",
            "text": text,
        })
    return lines


@login_required
def action_list_view(request, uuid):
    org = _current_org(request)
    project = get_visible_project_or_404(request, uuid)

    status = request.GET.get("status", "")
    if status not in dict(Action.STATUS_CHOICES):
        status = ""
    q = (request.GET.get("q") or "").replace("\x00", "").strip()[:100]
    assignee_raw = (request.GET.get("assignee") or "").strip()
    assignee, assignee_uuid = "", None
    if assignee_raw == "unassigned":
        assignee = "unassigned"
    else:
        try:
            assignee_uuid = uuid_lib.UUID(assignee_raw)
            assignee = str(assignee_uuid)
        except ValueError:
            pass

    top = Action.objects.filter(project=project, organization=org, parent__isnull=True)
    counts = dict(top.order_by().values_list("status").annotate(n=Count("pk")))

    actions = top.select_related("assignee__user").annotate(subtask_count=Count("subtasks"))
    if status:
        actions = actions.filter(status=status)
    if assignee == "unassigned":
        actions = actions.filter(assignee__isnull=True)
    elif assignee_uuid:
        actions = actions.filter(assignee__uuid=assignee_uuid)
    if q:
        actions = actions.filter(title__icontains=q)
    page = Paginator(actions.order_by("-created_at", "-pk"), PAGE_SIZE).get_page(
        request.GET.get("page")
    )

    tabs = [{
        "label": "All",
        "count": sum(counts.values()),
        "url": _list_url(project, q=q, assignee=assignee),
        "active": status == "",
    }]
    for value, label in Action.STATUS_CHOICES:
        tabs.append({
            "label": label,
            "count": counts.get(value, 0),
            "url": _list_url(project, status=value, q=q, assignee=assignee),
            "active": status == value,
        })

    team = (
        project.employees.filter(is_active=True)
        .select_related("user")
        .order_by("user__first_name", "user__last_name")
    )
    return render(request, "app_projects/action_list.html", {
        "project": project,
        "page": page,
        "tabs": tabs,
        "team": team,
        "status": status,
        "q": q,
        "assignee": assignee,
        "base_query": urlencode(
            {k: v for k, v in (("status", status), ("q", q), ("assignee", assignee)) if v}
        ),
        "can_edit": _can_edit(request, org, project),
        "today": timezone.localdate(),
    })


@login_required
def action_detail_view(request, uuid, action_uuid):
    org = _current_org(request)
    project = get_visible_project_or_404(request, uuid)
    action = _get_action(project, action_uuid)
    subtasks = list(
        action.subtasks.select_related("assignee__user").order_by("created_at", "pk")
    )
    events = list(action.events.select_related("actor"))
    manager = can_manage_projects(request.user, org)
    comments = list(action.comments.select_related("author"))
    for c in comments:
        c.can_modify = manager or c.author_id == request.user.pk
    attachments = list(action.attachments.select_related("uploaded_by"))
    for a in attachments:
        a.can_delete = manager or a.uploaded_by_id == request.user.pk
    return render(request, "app_projects/action_detail.html", {
        "project": project,
        "action": action,
        "subtasks": subtasks,
        "history": _history(events, org),
        "comments": comments,
        "attachments": attachments,
        "can_write": not project.is_archived,
        "can_change_status": services.can_change_status(request.user, action) and not project.is_archived,
        "status_choices": Action.STATUS_CHOICES,
        "reassign_form": ReassignForm(project=project, initial={"assignee": action.assignee_id}) if _can_edit(request, org, project) else None,
        "can_edit": _can_edit(request, org, project),
        "today": timezone.localdate(),
    })


@login_required
def action_create_view(request, uuid):
    org = _current_org(request)
    project = get_visible_project_or_404(request, uuid)
    _require_manage(request, org)
    if project.is_archived:
        messages.error(request, "This project is archived, so its actions are read-only.")
        return redirect(_list_url(project))

    form = ActionForm(
        request.POST if request.method == "POST" else None, project=project
    )
    if request.method == "POST" and form.is_valid():
        cd = form.cleaned_data
        try:
            action = services.create_action(
                project=project,
                actor=request.user,
                title=cd["title"],
                description=cd["description"],
                assignee=cd["assignee"],
                due_date=cd["due_date"],
            )
        except ValidationError as exc:
            _form_errors(form, exc)
        else:
            messages.success(request, "Action created.")
            return redirect(_detail_url(project, action))
    return render(request, "app_projects/action_form.html", {
        "form": form,
        "project": project,
        "page_title": "New action",
        "cancel_url": _list_url(project),
    })


@login_required
def action_edit_view(request, uuid, action_uuid):
    org = _current_org(request)
    project = get_visible_project_or_404(request, uuid)
    action = _get_action(project, action_uuid)
    _require_manage(request, org)
    if project.is_archived:
        messages.error(request, "This project is archived, so its actions are read-only.")
        return redirect(_detail_url(project, action))

    form = ActionForm(
        request.POST if request.method == "POST" else None,
        initial={
            "title": action.title,
            "description": action.description,
            "assignee": action.assignee_id,
            "due_date": action.due_date,
        },
        project=project,
        current_assignee_id=action.assignee_id,
    )
    if request.method == "POST" and form.is_valid():
        cd = form.cleaned_data
        new_assignee = cd["assignee"]
        try:
            with transaction.atomic():
                services.update_action(
                    action,
                    request.user,
                    title=cd["title"],
                    description=cd["description"],
                    due_date=cd["due_date"],
                )
                if (new_assignee.pk if new_assignee else None) != action.assignee_id:
                    services.reassign(action, new_assignee, request.user)
        except ValidationError as exc:
            _form_errors(form, exc)
        else:
            messages.success(request, "Action updated.")
            return redirect(_detail_url(project, action))
    return render(request, "app_projects/action_form.html", {
        "form": form,
        "project": project,
        "page_title": "Edit action",
        "cancel_url": _detail_url(project, action),
    })


@login_required
def my_actions_view(request):
    org = _current_org(request)
    profile_id = (
        empProfile.objects
        .filter(user=request.user, organization=org, is_active=True)
        .values_list("pk", flat=True)
        .first()
    )
    show_done = request.GET.get("done") == "1"
    actions = Action.objects.none()
    if profile_id:
        actions = Action.objects.filter(
            organization=org,
            assignee_id=profile_id,
            project__in=visible_projects(request),
        ).select_related("project", "assignee__user")
        if not show_done:
            actions = actions.filter(status__in=Action.OPEN_STATUSES)
        actions = actions.order_by(F("due_date").asc(nulls_last=True), "-created_at", "-pk")
    page = Paginator(actions, PAGE_SIZE).get_page(request.GET.get("page"))
    return render(request, "app_projects/my_actions.html", {
        "page": page,
        "show_done": show_done,
        "today": timezone.localdate(),
    })

@login_required
def action_attachment_download_view(request, uuid, action_uuid, attachment_uuid):
    project = get_visible_project_or_404(request, uuid)
    action = _get_action(project, action_uuid)
    att = _get_attachment(action, attachment_uuid)
    try:
        handle = att.file.storage.open(att.file.name, "rb")
    except (FileNotFoundError, ValueError):
        raise Http404("File not found.")
    response = FileResponse(
        handle,
        as_attachment=True,
        filename=att.original_name,
        content_type=att.content_type,
    )
    response["X-Content-Type-Options"] = "nosniff"
    response["Cache-Control"] = "private, no-store"
    return response

==> ./app_projects/filters.py <==
import uuid as uuid_lib

from .access import can_manage_projects
from .models import Project

FILTER_UNASSIGNED = "unassigned"


def can_use_project_filter(user, org):
    """Who sees the project dropdown. Admin-level only for now."""
    return can_manage_projects(user, org)


def clean_project_filter(org, raw):
    """Return "", "unassigned", or the uuid string of a project in this org."""
    raw = (raw or "").strip()
    if raw == FILTER_UNASSIGNED:
        return raw
    try:
        parsed = uuid_lib.UUID(raw)
    except (ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError):
        return ""
    if Project.objects.filter(organization=org, uuid=parsed).exists():
        return str(parsed)
    return ""


def apply_project_filter(queryset, selected, path="project"):
    """Narrow a queryset by project. path is the field path to the project."""
    if selected == FILTER_UNASSIGNED:
        return queryset.filter(**{path + "__isnull": True})
    if selected:
        return queryset.filter(**{path + "__uuid": selected})
    return queryset


def project_filter_context(request):
    """Template context for the dropdown, empty for users who may not use it."""
    org = getattr(request, "current_org", None)
    user = getattr(request, "user", None)
    if org is None or user is None or not can_use_project_filter(user, org):
        return {
            "project_filter_show": False,
            "project_filter_selected": "",
            "project_filter_options": [],
        }
    options = []
    for project in Project.objects.filter(organization=org).order_by("name"):
        label = project.name
        if project.status == Project.STATUS_ARCHIVED:
            label += " (archived)"
        options.append({"uuid": str(project.uuid), "label": label})
    return {
        "project_filter_show": True,
        "project_filter_selected": clean_project_filter(org, request.GET.get("project")),
        "project_filter_options": options,
    }

import uuid as uuid_lib
from urllib.parse import urlencode

from django.contrib import messages
from django.contrib.auth.decorators import login_required
from django.core.exceptions import PermissionDenied
from django.core.paginator import Paginator
from django.db import IntegrityError, transaction
from django.db.models import Count, Q
from django.shortcuts import redirect, render
from django.urls import reverse
from django.views.decorators.http import require_POST

from .access import (
    can_manage_projects,
    can_view_all_projects,
    get_visible_project_or_404,
    visible_projects,
)
from .forms import ProjectForm
from appEmp.models import empProfile

from .models import Project
from .services import actions_needing_reassign


def _current_org(request):
    org = getattr(request, "current_org", None)
    if org is None:
        raise PermissionDenied("No organization is linked to your account.")
    return org


def _require_manage(request, org):
    if not can_manage_projects(request.user, org):
        raise PermissionDenied("You do not have permission to manage projects.")


def _save(form, org):
    project = form.save(commit=False)
    project.organization = org
    try:
        with transaction.atomic():
            project.save()
    except IntegrityError:
        form.add_error(None, "A project with this name or code already exists.")
        return None
    return project


@login_required
def project_list_view(request):
    org = _current_org(request)
    view_all = can_view_all_projects(request.user, org)
    search = request.GET.get("q", "").strip()
    show_archived = request.GET.get("show_archived") == "1"

    projects = (
        visible_projects(request)
        .select_related("lead__user")
        .annotate(team_count=Count("employees", filter=Q(employees__is_active=True)))
    )
    if view_all and not show_archived:
        projects = projects.exclude(status=Project.STATUS_ARCHIVED)
    if search:
        projects = projects.filter(Q(name__icontains=search) | Q(code__icontains=search))

    return render(request, "app_projects/list.html", {
        "projects": projects,
        "search_query": search,
        "show_archived": show_archived,
        "view_all": view_all,
        "can_manage": can_manage_projects(request.user, org),
    })


@login_required
def project_detail_view(request, uuid):
    org = _current_org(request)
    project = get_visible_project_or_404(request, uuid)
    team = (
        project.employees.filter(is_active=True)
        .select_related("user")
        .order_by("user__first_name", "user__last_name")
    )
    return render(request, "app_projects/detail.html", {
        "project": project,
        "team": team,
        "reassign_list": (
            list(actions_needing_reassign(project).select_related("assignee__user")[:10])
            if can_manage_projects(request.user, org) else []
        ),
        "can_manage": can_manage_projects(request.user, org),
    })


@login_required
def project_create_view(request):
    org = _current_org(request)
    _require_manage(request, org)

    if request.method == "POST":
        form = ProjectForm(request.POST, organization=org)
        if form.is_valid():
            project = _save(form, org)
            if project is not None:
                messages.success(request, "Project created.")
                return redirect("projectDetail", uuid=project.uuid)
    else:
        form = ProjectForm(organization=org)

    return render(request, "app_projects/form.html", {
        "form": form,
        "project": None,
        "page_title": "Add Project",
    })


@login_required
def project_edit_view(request, uuid):
    org = _current_org(request)
    project = get_visible_project_or_404(request, uuid)
    _require_manage(request, org)

    if project.is_archived:
        messages.error(request, "This project is archived. Unarchive it before editing.")
        return redirect("projectDetail", uuid=project.uuid)

    if request.method == "POST":
        form = ProjectForm(request.POST, instance=project, organization=org)
        if form.is_valid():
            saved = _save(form, org)
            if saved is not None:
                messages.success(request, "Project updated.")
                return redirect("projectDetail", uuid=saved.uuid)
    else:
        form = ProjectForm(instance=project, organization=org)

    return render(request, "app_projects/form.html", {
        "form": form,
        "project": project,
        "page_title": "Edit Project",
    })


@login_required
@require_POST
def project_archive_view(request, uuid):
    org = _current_org(request)
    project = get_visible_project_or_404(request, uuid)
    _require_manage(request, org)
    if not project.is_archived:
        project.archive()
        messages.success(request, "Project archived. It is now read-only.")
    return redirect("projectDetail", uuid=project.uuid)


@login_required
@require_POST
def project_unarchive_view(request, uuid):
    org = _current_org(request)
    project = get_visible_project_or_404(request, uuid)
    _require_manage(request, org)
    if project.is_archived:
        project.status = Project.STATUS_ACTIVE
        project.save(update_fields=["status", "updated_at"])
        messages.success(request, "Project unarchived.")
    return redirect("projectDetail", uuid=project.uuid)


ASSIGN_PAGE_SIZE = 50
ASSIGN_UNASSIGN = "none"
ASSIGN_FILTER_UNASSIGNED = "unassigned"


def _parse_uuid(value):
    try:
        return uuid_lib.UUID(str(value).strip())
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return None


def _assignable_projects(org):
    return (
        Project.objects.filter(organization=org)
        .exclude(status=Project.STATUS_ARCHIVED)
        .order_by("name")
    )


def _clean_project_filter(org, raw):
    raw = (raw or "").strip()
    if raw == ASSIGN_FILTER_UNASSIGNED:
        return raw
    parsed = _parse_uuid(raw)
    if parsed and Project.objects.filter(organization=org, uuid=parsed).exists():
        return str(parsed)
    return ""


def _assign_url(request):
    params = {}
    for key in ("q", "project", "page"):
        value = request.POST.get(key, "").strip()
        if value:
            params[key] = value
    url = reverse("projectAssign")
    if params:
        url += "?" + urlencode(params)
    return url


def _assign_apply(request, org):
    target_raw = request.POST.get("target", "").strip()
    if target_raw == ASSIGN_UNASSIGN:
        new_project = None
    else:
        parsed = _parse_uuid(target_raw)
        new_project = (
            _assignable_projects(org).filter(uuid=parsed).first() if parsed else None
        )
        if new_project is None:
            messages.error(
                request,
                "Choose a project that is active or on hold, or choose Unassigned.",
            )
            return

    selected = {value.strip() for value in request.POST.getlist("employees") if value.strip()}
    if not selected:
        messages.error(request, "Select at least one employee.")
        return

    valid = {parsed for parsed in (_parse_uuid(value) for value in selected) if parsed}
    employees = list(
        empProfile.objects
        .filter(organization=org, is_active=True, uuid__in=valid)
        .select_related("project")
    )
    skipped = len(selected) - len(employees)

    target_id = new_project.pk if new_project is not None else None
    counts = {"assigned": 0, "moved": 0, "unassigned": 0, "unchanged": 0}

    with transaction.atomic():
        for employee in employees:
            if employee.project_id == target_id:
                counts["unchanged"] += 1
                continue
            before = employee.project_id
            employee.project = new_project
            employee.save(update_fields=["project", "updated_at"])
            if new_project is None:
                counts["unassigned"] += 1
            elif before is None:
                counts["assigned"] += 1
            else:
                counts["moved"] += 1

    parts = []
    if counts["assigned"]:
        parts.append("%d assigned" % counts["assigned"])
    if counts["moved"]:
        parts.append("%d moved" % counts["moved"])
    if counts["unassigned"]:
        parts.append("%d unassigned" % counts["unassigned"])
    if counts["unchanged"]:
        parts.append("%d already in that project" % counts["unchanged"])

    changed = counts["assigned"] + counts["moved"] + counts["unassigned"]
    if changed:
        messages.success(request, "Done: " + ", ".join(parts) + ".")
    elif parts:
        messages.info(request, "No changes: " + ", ".join(parts) + ".")
    if skipped:
        messages.warning(request, "%d selected employee(s) could not be found and were skipped." % skipped)


@login_required
def project_assign_view(request):
    org = _current_org(request)
    _require_manage(request, org)

    if request.method == "POST":
        _assign_apply(request, org)
        return redirect(_assign_url(request))

    search = request.GET.get("q", "").strip()[:100]
    project_filter = _clean_project_filter(org, request.GET.get("project"))

    employees = (
        empProfile.objects
        .filter(organization=org, is_active=True)
        .select_related("user", "designation", "project")
        .order_by("user__first_name", "user__last_name", "pk")
    )
    for term in search.split():
        employees = employees.filter(
            Q(user__first_name__icontains=term)
            | Q(user__last_name__icontains=term)
            | Q(designation__name__icontains=term)
        )
    if project_filter == ASSIGN_FILTER_UNASSIGNED:
        employees = employees.filter(project__isnull=True)
    elif project_filter:
        employees = employees.filter(project__uuid=project_filter)

    page_obj = Paginator(employees, ASSIGN_PAGE_SIZE).get_page(request.GET.get("page"))

    return render(request, "app_projects/assign.html", {
        "page_obj": page_obj,
        "search_query": search,
        "project_filter": project_filter,
        "target_projects": _assignable_projects(org),
        "filter_projects": Project.objects.filter(organization=org).order_by("name"),
        "can_manage": True,
    })
